r:
It's September 25th, 2024. A long awaited game is finally about to be released. That game is Sburb. 

Follow 6 friends as they make their way through this life-changing game, on an adventure filled with comedy, action and heartache.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/2_ryan_intro.gif[/img]

A young man stands in his bedroom. Normally this day, the 25th of September 2024, would hold no particular significance to him; but today is the release date of a game he has been anxiously awaiting for quite some time. That game is known as Sburb. 

As for the young man himself, though it was approximately fourteen and a half years since he was given life, it is only today he will be given a name. What shall the name of this young man be?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/3_ryan_name.gif[/img]

You try to enter a particularly insulting name, but the boy notices something's up. Alright, fine, you'll let him off the hook for now. You decide to back out and just write down his real name instead.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/4_ryan_roomexamine.gif[/img]

Your name is RYAN SEARS. As was previously mentioned, today will see the release of the long-awaited SBURB. It hasn't released quite yet though, so you are currently killing time by doing ABSOLUTELY NOTHING. 

You have a variety of INTERESTS, such as VIDEO GAMES. You are especially a fan of games from VALVE SOFTWARE, as well as various INDIE DEVELOPERS. You yearn to one day become an INDIE GAME DEVELOPER yourself. Your favorite genres of games are FIRST PERSON SHOOTERS and the occasional ROLE PLAYING GAME. 

You also enjoy reading WEB COMICS, including the highly coveted HOMESTUCK. This is, of course, the reason as to why you are so HYPED to finally get to play SBURB yourself. There is still time before it releases, so until then...

What will you do?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/5_ryan_poster1.gif[/img]

Above your bed are your treasured posters from some of Valve's best games. Over here is your TEAM FORTRESS 2 "VICTORY" poster, and on top of it is your HALF-LIFE 3 "I WANT TO BELIEVE" poster. 

You really want to believe too, but alas, Half-Life 3 will never come... You really thought it would have been announced by now after they released Half-Life Alyx a few years back, but now that Sburb is about to release as well, it seems like Half-Life 3 would never have seen the light of day anyway. 

At least Half-Life Alyx was really good, even if you had to watch a playthrough online because you can't afford a VR setup.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/6_ryan_poster2.gif[/img]

And over here is a poster from PORTAL 2, based on what you genuinely believe might just be the greatest piece of dialog in gaming history.

"GET MAD! I don't want your damn LEMONS, what am I supposed to do with these?! Do you know who I am?? I'm the man who's gonna BURN YOUR HOUSE DOWN. With the LEMONS." 

-Cave Johnson, founder and CEO of Aperture Science

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/7_ryan_calendar.gif[/img]

You've made sure to mark today's date on your special calendar. You also drew Sburb's logo a while back to celebrate the big day. It is admittedly crude, but you've never considered yourself to be much of an artist.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/8_ryan_shelf.gif[/img]

This shelf is where you keep your various other prized possessions, such as some action figures and the like. All from your favorite games, of course.

From bottom to top, you have:
an ATLAS FIGURE from PORTAL 2,
a BULLDOZER BOBBLEHEAD from PAYDAY 2,
a PYRO FIGURE from TEAM FORTRESS 2,
an ENGINEER FIGURE from TEAM FORTRESS 2,
a SANS PLUSH from UNDERTALE,
and a PORTAL GUN REPLICA from PORTAL.

p.c: Ryan: Play something to pass the time.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/9_ryan_desk.gif[/img]

You thought about just waiting for Sburb to arrive so you could download and play it without delay, but you have a feeling it might not drop for another few hours. You guess killing some time with another game wouldn't hurt anyone. Except for the time, of course. Your friends will undoubtedly alert you if Sburb releases earlier than expected.

You take a seat at your desk, where you display another one of your special possessions; a GRAVITY GUN REPLICA from HALF-LIFE 2.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/10_ryan_screen1.gif[/img]

This is your desktop, the place where you spend most of your time. Your desktop background was made by YOURSELF in SOURCE FILMMAKER. It is a screenshot of an animation project you've been working on in your spare time. You're pretty proud of this shot, even if it's unfinished. 

Besides that, your desktop is pretty barren. You prefer keeping it clean and tidy, displaying only the essentials such as STEAM, your web browser MACHINAS, and of course, PESTERCHUM. Rather, a recreation of Homestuck's Pesterchum by a fellow fan. You and your friends felt the true Sburb experience would be incomplete without it.

You don't see any alerts coming from Pesterchum, so you might as well open Steam and go play some games for the time being.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/11_ryan_steam1.gif[/img]

You take a look through your list of games on Steam. What to play, what to play...

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/12_ryan_steam2.gif[/img]

You eventually decide to settle on playing one of your favorites of the bunch: TEAM FORTRESS 2. You're honestly surprised it still has a pretty active playerbase despite its age, but you're glad it does. There's just something special about this game that no other multiplayer game could ever replicate.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/13_ryan_tf2.gif[/img]

Time passes, and you're still going strong. That said, as you play you start to feel a bit of frustration brewing. You kind of have a short temper when it comes to difficult or competitive games like this, even if you aren't really the super-competitive type. You're trying to work on that.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/14_ryan_firstrage.gif[/img]

That said, now would probably be a good time to quit. You don't want to get worked up, and Sburb could release at any moment now. Oh, and hey, it looks like someone started pestering you earlier! Who could it be..?

...Oh. It's him. Yeah, you don't think your mood's gonna improve much in this conversation.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/25_ryan_leaveroom.gif[/img]

You were already hungry before, but all that jumping around and hyped-up conversation has amplified that hunger ten-fold.

You don't have much else to do while you wait for Sburb to download, so you figure now's the best time to go and eat something.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/26_ryan_hallway.gif[/img]

You step outside your room and find yourself in your hallway. There's a couple photos on the wall of you and your bro, as well as a drawing you made when you were younger.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/27_ryan_hallway2.gif[/img]

And this door leads to your bro's room. You don't have much reason to go in there right now, so you decide to just ignore it and go downstairs.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/28_ryan_livingroom1.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/28_2_ryan_livingroom1.gif[/img]

You are now in your living room. The kitchen is just around the corner, past the couch and TV.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/29_ryan_kitchen1.gif[/img]

You are now in the kitchen. It's time for some snacks!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/30_ryan_kitchen2.gif[/img]

Hm? Wait, what's that on the fridge?

...Oh for Christ's sake..

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/31_ryan_noteexamine.gif[/img]

It's another one of your brother's stupid Slender Man pages. That guy is way too into that mythos, seriously... Kinda creeps you out a little.

You're getting pretty tired of seeing this stuff showing up everywhere around the house. You know, maybe there WAS a reason to go see him in his room after all.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/32_ryan_stormtheroom.gif[/img]

You quickly eat some snacks before heading back upstairs to confront your brother.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/33_ryan_broroom.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/33_2_ryan_broroom.gif[/img]

Huh? He's not here? That's odd, it's usually nigh impossible to get him out of his chair.

Well, while he's out, you suppose you'll just snoop around his room a little.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/34_ryan_broscreen.gif[/img]

You turn his computer monitor back on to find his web browser open on MSPFA. You think this might be [url=https://mspfa.com/?s=54766&p=1]an adventure he's working on.[/url] It seems like it's still in its infancy though. In fact, looking closer, this appears to be a "demo" version of a bigger adventure. Whatever it is, it doesn't look too bad. You think about leaving a suggestion in the comments... but maybe later.

There doesn't seem to be anything else of interest on his computer right now.

Suddenly, you hear a noise downstairs. You think that might be him. Well, time to go down and talk to him before he catches you snooping around in here.

p.c: Ryan: Go confront brother. For real.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/35_ryan_darklivingroom.gif[/img]

Why are the lights off now? You can only assume your brother turned them off, but why? Whatever the case, you can't see a damn thing. You should go turn the lights back on, or open a curtain.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/36_ryan_stalked.gif[/img]

You're getting a strange feeling. You can't quite describe it, but it feels like someone, or something, may be watching you...

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/37_ryan_jun.gif[/img]

Well, okay, but you're sure there's nothing theEEAAAH JESUS CHRIST

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/38_jeff_intro.gif[/img]

You abscond so hard, you switch the focus to another character!

A young man stands in his room. A very special game he has been waiting years to play has JUST RELEASED, and he is BEYOND excited to finally play it! But unfortunately for him, his internet seems to be having issues. He was just about to go and investigate the problem, when some kind of force compelled him to stand at his door and wait patiently to be introduced to the audience.

Speaking of which, there's an important matter we must address before he can get on with his mission. This young man's name!

What will the name of this young man be?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/39_jeff_namefail.gif[/img]

You attempt to enter the insulting name you tried previously. It predictably fails, but what you didn't expect was just how unfazed this boy would be. If anything, he might even LIKE that name.

This kid sure is one imperturbable gamer.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/40_jeff_namesuccess.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/41_jeff_roomexamine.gif[/img]

Your name is JEFF. And yes, it's hard to tell people that with a straight face. Anyway, as was previously mentioned, a COOL AND NEW GAME called SBURB has just dropped! But, so has your INTERNET. You are currently standing in your room, ready to head on out to fix it. You make sure to keep your room CLEAN and BARE, save for your HOMESTUCK POSTER on the wall.

Speaking of which, you are a big fan of VIDEO GAMES and WEBCOMICS, especially HOMESTUCK. But.. that's pretty much it. You don't have that many interests, and as such, you sometimes find it hard to make new friends. You might say you're quite SOCIALLY AWKWARD. 

Enough about you, though. You have a modem to fix!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/42_jeff_windowlook.gif[/img]

But, before that, you decide to take a look out your window. Jeez, the sunset's bright today. Well, at least you have an answer as to why you're always wearing your cool shades, if anyone asks. It's definitely because of the bright sun, and absolutely not because Dave is your favorite Homestuck character. Not in the slightest.

...What were you doing again? Oh, right, the modem. You should probably get on that.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/43_jeff_livingroom.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/43_2_jeff_livingroom.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/43_3_jeff_livingroom.gif[/img]

You promptly leave your room and start searching for the modem. You're pretty sure it's in your sister's study. You don't have the time to slowly trudge through your house examining every little thing for no reason, so you decide to skip all of that and head to the study without further delay.

...Though, you can't help but pause a moment to look at a few photos in your hallway, of your sister and yourself.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/44_jeff_study.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/44_2_jeff_study.gif[/img]

Here we are. You can see the modem over on the desk.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/45_jeff_modem.gif[/img]

You hit the power button. The modem should automatically turn back on in a few minutes. Hopefully that's enough to fix it for the time being.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/46_jeff_modem2.gif[/img]

There we go! Your internet should be in full working order again.

You hope your sister wasn't using the internet for anything. She's probably gonna be pissed if she was.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/47_jeff_prefight.gif[/img]

You leave the study and head back to your room. You're confident there'll be nobody on the other side of the door, ready to fight you for turning off the internet without permission. Absolutely nobody.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/50_jeff_sisterlook2.gif[/img]

Whaddaya know. It's your sister, and she looks predictably pissed.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/51_jeff_sisterpan.gif[/img]

It seems your sister is challenging you to a STRIFE. Unfortunately, it also seems you don't have a weapon equipped! You use a riflekind specibus, so you'll have to pay a visit to the gun cabinet to grab yourself a rifle.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1_remake/52_jeff_panned.gif[/img]

Your inability to STRIFE does not dissuade your sister, however, and you proceed to take a swift panning to the face!

As you step outside to look directly into the sun for whatever reason, you can feel the wind move around you, skimming past your face and producing that familiar note. The note Desolation plays. Or something like that. You kinda forgot how the speech goes.

You look into the fields stretching behind your home. The empty, flat land that expands beyond your line of sight over the horizon, and you begin to reminisce. You remember your life here, among the seemingly endless field, alone with only your brother and strangers on the other side of your computer screen. It was.. pleasant. You were content.

But alas, it's almost time to leave it all behind. To make a hero of yourself somewhere else. You look into the distance for the final time.

It's going to be a long day.

You stop being the other kid just in time to see something interesting going on here. 

Your KERNELSPRITE has been prototyped with OPERIA OCKRUS. It looks like you have also moved your desk to accommodate space for the TOTEM LATHE. It also seems like the countdown on the CRUXTRUDER hasn't begun yet, despite the KERNELSPRITE being released and prototyped. Perhaps it's just being slow?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1/123_jeff_livingroom.gif[/img]

There's no need to wonder; you already know she placed it in your living room! While we're here, you guess you might as well inspect the room.

Those stairs lead up to your room and your sister's. To the right of the room is the ALCHEMITER. AD decided to move the TV and the cabinet to make way for it. What is it with her and cabinets today? 

Anyway, the door next to the ALCHEMITER leads to the STUDY ROOM. Important documents and items shared between you and your sister are kept there. Neither of you really go in there nowadays however, except to restart the modem whenever it goes down, like earlier today.

On the floor is a RUG. ...Yeah.

Next to the stairs is the SOFA. You were really the only one in the house who ever uses it; your sister never really comes out of her room to watch TV or anything like that. Behind the SOFA is another door. Where does this lead? Why is the sofa in front of it? You're honestly not quite sure yourself. You've never opened it. Not out of fear or anything, but just because you have never really given the mystery door much care or interest. You're not even sure if your sister has ever ventured back there for the same reasons. 

On the two sides of the room we can't currently see are a WINDOW and the FRONT DOOR. And that's about it for the living room. Let's go back and see what's going on in your room again, shall we?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1/124_jeff_missing.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1/125_jeff_found.gif[/img]

Ugh, whatever. What are you gonna do now?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1/126_jeff_alchemizing.gif[/img]

What on earth are you doing?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1/127_jeff_pgo.gif[/img]

Congrats. You made a Perfectly Generic Object. Great work. Definitely not a colossal waste of time for everyone involved. Can we move onto something more important now? Like, you know, NOT dying to the impending meteor? The Cruxtruder just started counting down, you know.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1/128_jeff_holygoditsapgo.gif[/img]

Why the hell are you so enamoured by this goddamn green cube? How? You're minutes away from death, and you choose to instead stare longingly at the most worthless and generic object in existence? 

Alright, clearly Jeff is too breath-taken by this cube to do any real work, so I'm shifting this story right back to the other kid again.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1/129_hellothere.gif[/img]

No no no, not her. She hasn't been introduced yet. I mean the OTHER other kid. The first kid.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act1/130_ryan_lathe.gif[/img]

There we go. Looks like this guy's actually getting stuff done. What a twist.

An old, unkempt building sits in the middle of a post-apocalyptic wasteland.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/142_fo_look.gif[/img]

Somebody is here.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/143_fo_knocking.gif[/img]

The door appears rusted. It needs to be opened with a pass-code, but the keypad on the other side is gone. It cannot be opened by traditional means anymore. The visitor resorts to trying to knock the door down. Should be an easy task for them.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/144_doordown.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/145_fo_appear.gif[/img]

A FUGACIOUS OBSERVER appears in the doorway.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/146_gc_appear.gif[/img]

They are being trailed by a GARRULOUS COLLABORATOR.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/147_exiles_investigate.gif[/img]

This building, whatever it used to be, looks like it was destroyed intentionally to make room for different machinery.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/148_exiles_screens.gif[/img]

At the end of the room lies a set of 5 big screens, with a control panel at its base.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/149_keyboard.gif[/img]

This command should turn on all the screens. You might be able to see all the heroes this way.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter1/150_exiles_screenon.gif[/img]

The screens flash to life, displaying broken images of 5 of the 6 heroes. Where's the sixth? Hmm. Perhaps you need to input a different command to view him. But, later, you guess. It's been a very long day. You both need some rest.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/151_black.gif[/img]

Did.. did you make it in time? Is it over? You have just reawakened, yet your eyes remain closed. You can feel your body sandwiched between your bed's mattress and blanket. But, wasn't that bed destroyed?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/152_eyesopen.gif[/img]

You open your eyes, but having just woken up, your eyelids still feel heavy. It's tough to keep them open when you've just woken up.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/153_fp_prospitroom.gif[/img]

You fight to open your eyes fully, though it's still hard to see. You'll need to equip your glasses. From what you can make out, though, you are indeed in a fixed bed, in your room. Sigh. The whole thing was just a dream, wasn't it? Damn it. You were so excited, but now you just feel disappointed as hell. Yeah, what was dream-you thinking? Sburb isn't real. That's impossible.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/154_dreamryan_wake.gif[/img]

Well, you might as well get up. You probably have school today, knowing your luck. How fun that'll be.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/155_dreamryan_notice.gif[/img]

Yeah, good idea, you'll need.. those....

Oh..

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/156_dreamryan_room.gif[/img]

Well, one thing's for sure, you're wide awake now. So that WAS real. Though, that being said, why are you here? What happened to your real self? Eh, you'll find out later. It's just good to at least know that all the hype over the last few years you've built up wasn't just a huge lie. Either that, or you're still in a very long, very lucid dream, but you're not gonna let that hypothetical ruin your time here. 

Looking around your room on Prospit, you can see it's pretty much the same as your real room, except not all messed up by your co-player. Though, you did notice those crude drawings on the wall. You probably drew them yourself without knowing, now they're gonna show up in the real world, but you honestly don't care much about that. The badly drawn trees and.. whatever the hell that weird Navi looking thing is won't ruin your time either.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/157_dreamryan_window.gif[/img]

You stand on the windowsill and look out.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/158_prospit.gif[/img]

You look out at the gargantuan, sprawling golden city below.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/159_dreamryan_fly.gif[/img]

You fly down from the moon to the planet itself.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/160_dreamryan_fly2.gif[/img]

Looks like open hoodies and jade shirts is currently the new fashion trend around here. You know where the hoodies came from, but you don't really know what prompted the jade theme. You guess that might've been Jeff prototyping something. Did he make it in okay? You sure hope so.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/161_dreamryan_blursanslook.gif[/img]

You try to investigate more of the city, but you are stopped by a ghostly orange entity. You can barely make out its appearance, but you can swear it's talking to you. It sounds like it's telling you to wake up.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/162_dreamryan_blursans.gif[/img]

You try to focus on it a little more. You think it might be.. Sansprite? What's going on with him? You try to say something to him, but he doesn't respond with anything more than a distant, distorted "wake up." Is he even here, or is this just a bizarre projection of him? You believe the latter theory is likely the correct one.

You don't think you should stay out here much longer. You feel like looking into the clouds from the comfort of your room again.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/163_dreamryan_chainfly.gif[/img]

You fly up towards Prospit's moon again, alongside its massive chain.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/164_dreamryan_roomreturn.gif[/img]

You arrive back at your room. You look down at someone else's room off in the distance. You'd like to go check who's inhabiting it, but you think you'll hold off on that for now. Maybe after the cloud show is over.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/165_skaiaclouds1.gif[/img]

A cloud passes by your room. In it, you can see a flood of red. You can just make out trees and a metallic path between them. This must be someone's planet. Maybe it's yours?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/166_skaiaclouds2.gif[/img]

Another cloud passes by. You can see a troll-themed sprite in it. He looks a little distressed.. This must be Jeff's sprite! Or, someone else's in the future? Who is that troll, anyway? Someone's trollsona? Dang, that's a cool idea. You wish you had thought about that sooner. Not that Sans was a bad choice, but you just have a feeling he'd end up being the odd-one-out among a whole bunch of fantroll sprites. 

What does he look so worried about, anyway? Oh, god. That's worrying you, a little. You hope your friends are/will be okay..

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/167_skaia_brook.gif[/img]

Another cloud. Hey, that's LA! And, that's also our cue to introduce her, finally! Yes. Definitely. I'm definitely going to introduce LA right here, right now. I'm definitely not going to switch to somebody else and pretend this not-so-subtle build up never happened.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/168_brook_intro.gif[/img]

..Really, I'm not doing that.

A young girl stands in her room. She was just playing a newly-released, long awaited game with one of her good friends, and she is now-

Actually, nah, this intro is a bit too cliche at this point. Let's just name this girl, shall we?

p.c: Try that one insulting name again.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/169_brook_namegag.gif[/img]

Nah, that gag seems too cliche as well, and judging from the look on the girl's face, she agrees. How about we just drop that whole thing and get to some actual introductions?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/170_brook_room.gif[/img]

Your name is BROOK PHILIPS. As was mentioned previously in that gag that we shall never speak of again, you were just playing SBURB, a newly-released and highly anticipated game with your good friend RYAN. You also set up a CONNECTION LOOP for your other friends to join, with the help of some MYSTERIOUS CONTACTS.

Your interests include ROBOTICS, MATHEMATICS, and JUST ABOUT ANYTHING MECHANICAL AND TECHNOLOGICAL. You aspire to be a ROBOTICS ENGINEER or a PROFESSIONAL PROGRAMMER in the future, or at least, you used to, before SBURB became a thing. You still hope to one day achieve these goals, however, even if you have to CREATE A WHOLE NEW UNIVERSE TO DO IT. You like MATHS, which is probably a result of your LOVE FOR ROBOTS. You guess you also enjoy it because maths in your mind has a STRICT ZERO-BULLSHIT POLICY. You heard that quote in SOME VIDEO ON THE INTERNET and now you like to use it whenever the topic of MATHS arises. 

You also have a huge interest in VIDEO GAMES, as do all of your friends, though, you're more a fan of the OLDER, MORE CLASSICAL TITLES. Your favourite out of all of them is CHRONO TRIGGER. You should probably go check on your co-player now, but you're ALWAYS OPEN FOR OTHER IDEAS.

That being said, what will you do now?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/171_brook_shelflook.gif[/img]

This cupboard is where you store most of your notes and books. In the drawers are piles upon piles of paper with many different mathematical equations, diagrams and other miscellaneous notes pertaining to your interests.

Sitting on top are some books, including, but not limited to, "ROBOTICS FOR BEGINNERS", "BASIC EDUCATION IN MATHEMATICS", and "TECHNOLOGY FOR ASSHOLES", though you always leave that last one buried at the bottom of the pile. 

You also have some toy robot on here that you got as a birthday gift years ago. You don't exactly "play" with it however. You instead prefer to just observe its behaviour. You used to, though. You took out most of its innards to see how it moves and how it thinks. Now it's just a mostly useless husk that just sits on top of the cupboard.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/172_brook_posterlook.gif[/img]

You've plastered many posters across the walls around your bed. You have, from left to right:

A MAP OF MATHEMATICS POSTER. It's not too useful as a tool to help with maths. It's more so just a representation of your love for the topic. 

A CHRONO TRIGGER POSTER. As you stated previously, Chrono Trigger is your all-time favourite game! You love the characters, you love the soundtrack, you love the fighting mechanics.. It's truly a masterpiece of a game. 

A VISUAL GUIDE TO ROBOTS & CYBORGS POSTER. To be honest, when you first heard the name of this poster, you thought it would be some kind of diagram. You admit you were a little disappointed when you found out it was just a list of robots from popular TV shows and movies and stuff like that. You still hung it on the wall, though. Just because it was slightly disappointing doesn't mean it sucks. You actually found some of your new favourite shows and movies through this poster.

A COOL-LOOKING MECHANICAL-STYLED POSTER. You have no idea what this is portraying, but it looks really cool. 

A TRIGONOMETRY POSTER. You like trigonometry above most other mathematical topics. You're not too sure why. It's just a perfect balance of easy and challenging for you.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/173_brook_wardrobelook.gif[/img]

You'd rather not. Asking to inspect a girl's wardrobe is an extremely rude gesture for a start. You don't even have anything of interest in there. Just spare clothes. 

You'd prefer to keep its contents private.

Before you leave, you decide to put this new modus to the test. You use the GAS MASK on yourself, which activates the card, propelling a relatively small amount of bullets your way. 

Pretty sweet modus. And now you've got a pretty sweet mask as well. But, you think it could look a little better with some alchemy. You'll leave it on for now though.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/359_ryan_designix.gif[/img]

You go back inside. Hey, there's the Designix! Thank you, Brook! You'll come back to this later once you've nabbed some stuff from your room.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/360_ryan_roomenter.gif[/img]

You find yourself back in your room. Hey, it looks a little different in here. Did something change? Did your bro do something to it? It looks a little more spacious in here than before.

(the joke is that i redesigned ryan's room so it doesn't look like shit anymore there's actually nothing really that different about it though)

You immediately decide to stop with the pointless and unfunny meta commentary and get back to work.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/361_ryan_itemcollect.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/361_2_ryan_gravgun.gif[/img]

You take all of your collectable items, such as the BROKEN PORTAL GUN REPLICA and the GRAVITY GUN REPLICA. You bet a lot of these could make for some really cool alchemy based items. 

You also take note of your laptop's captcha code, as you will most likely use that in your little alchemy montage. You then proceed back downstairs to punch the cards, then you get some totems out of the Cruxtruder, then you carve some totems, but we don't see any of this happening because it's boring and we want to get to the cool alchemy montage as quick as possible.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/434_ashley_books_examine.gif[/img]

Here are some of the books you've collected over the years. You don't consider yourself to be much of a reader, but you do pick up a book every now and then, usually during a particularly boring day, or if you're seeking inspiration for your own work.

Most of these books are just miscellaneous pieces of literature, but the two books on the bottom shelf were given to you by some of your good friends. On the bottom is a journal, given to you by RYAN. This journal contains entries written by a troubled child, who had spent his life being stalked by a mysterious eldritch horror. The journal documents his horrific experiences with the creature, along with his investigation into the secret life of his crazed and selfish mother. According to Ryan, this book is part of a much larger story, originating from an online horror series of some sort. You don't know the name of it, and while you would like to watch it yourself, you haven't gotten around to asking Ryan for its name.

The book resting on top of it was given to you by JEFF. You don't know much about this book at all. You've been meaning to read it for a little while now, but you've just sort of been procrastinating on it. You'll eventually pick it up, you swear. Jeff gave you this book because it apparently reminded him of you. Well, those weren't his exact words. He was a little more roundabout with his reason. It reminded him of a character from a video game that in turn reminded him of you. He seemed pretty reluctant to tell you what this video game was for whatever reason, so you didn't get the name of that one either.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/435_ashley_stairsexamine.gif[/img]

These stairs have been broken for about as long as you can remember. You guess they might have just rotted away? Maybe they broke under some heavy weight? You're completely unsure how this happened, but you can't go upstairs anymore. You've never been upstairs before.

You would ask your DAD what happened to the stairs, but he left you here alone many, many years ago and never returned. You were never too saddened by this. He wasn't the greatest caretaker. And besides, you like being alone here. Luckily for you, if you ever needed help of some kind, your neighbor and her mother have always been there for you. You'd even go as far as to consider her mother to be your own as well.

p.c: Ashley: Examine the other side of the room.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/436_ashley_kitchenexamine.gif[/img]

On the other side of the living room is a small, built-in kitchen, complete with a few more of your trademark knives. You guess there's also a sort of mini-bar here too? There's a bar-stool here, which is pretty much your only seat besides the floor if you want to watch TV. You couldn't bother getting a sofa, since you never watched much TV to begin with, and the stool isn't too uncomfortable.

p.c: Ashley: Quit messing around! The clock's ticking.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act2/437_ashley_preenter.gif[/img]

Yes, you're right. You did kind of space out there for a moment, letting valuable entry time go to waste. You really ought to get this show on the road now, before it's too late.

You reach for your front door.
It's time to be a fucking hero.

Your name is APRIL TIFFANY. Today, you're planning to play SBURB with your five other FRIENDS. Two of your friends are currently already in the MEDIUM. 

Your interests include GARDENING and BAKING. You find these tasks peaceful and rewarding, always providing either something beautiful to look at or a delicious snack to eat. You always make sure to share your food with anybody who happens to be in the area, mainly your MOTHER and your NEIGHBOR / BEST FRIEND, ASHLEY ARIA. You also enjoy WRITING FANFICTION and DRAWING, though most of your work only portrays you and your friends. You love sharing your stories with your friends, but you have to be a little careful sometimes. A lot of your work involves themes of ROMANCE, you see. You'd hate to make your friends feel uncomfortable.

Speaking of which, one of your favorite things to do is CHAT WITH YOUR FRIENDS. You've never met the majority of them, but despite that, you absolutely LOVE and ADORE every single one of them. Well, maybe not so much THAT ONE GUY, but you have a lot of FAITH in his ability to become a better person, and you'd be MORE THAN HAPPY to HELP him. You VERY RARELY PLAY VIDEO GAMES, but you find them FUN and enjoy playing them sometimes with your FRIENDS. You also like to play your GUITAR sometimes.

What will you do now?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/534_april_deskexamine.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/614_brook_hallway.gif[/img]

You are now in your hallway. Hopefully Genzusprite can keep her occupied while you tend to your wound. You can probably find a first aid kit or something in your bathroom.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/615_brook_bathroom.gif[/img]

You enter the bathroom. Your mirror can open up to reveal a cabinet. You should start there.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/616_brook_mirroropen.gif[/img]

You open the mirror. Bottles of pills make up most of the space. Probably medicine or something. You don't really need any of that right now.

Further in the back, you can see the first aid kit you were looking for, as well as something else.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/617_brook_firstaid.gif[/img]

You take the kit. This will come in handy.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/618_brook_moduslook.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/618_2_brook_modus.gif[/img]

Looking back in the cabinet, you can see what the first aid kit was hiding. It's your old Math modus! You've been wondering where this thing went. 

It works like most other modi, in the sense that you can pick up pretty much whatever you want. When you try to use an item however, you have to solve a math puzzle, the difficulty increasing with the object's size, mass and overall significance. A simple but sweet mechanic, in your eyes.

Ahem. Eye.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/619_brook_eyepatch.gif[/img]

You take a patch and a bandage from the kit. You can use this as a rudimentary eye patch.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/620_brook_patch.gif[/img]

You clean up the blood on your face and cover the wound with the patch. Perfect.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/621_brook_glasses.gif[/img]

Now, about your glasses..

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/622_brook_glassclear.gif[/img]

You can't be having this broken, bloody glass just sitting here. You very quickly dispose of the pieces.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/623_brook_readytogo.gif[/img]

There. Good as new, you guess.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/624_brook_glasseson.gif[/img]

You know, you were initially put off quite a bit by this eye wound of yours. But you've gotta say, it's already grown on you. You feel like a badass with this eye patch. Even if the look is just ever so slightly cliche and edgy.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/625_april_corner.gif[/img]

You've been sitting in the corner for some time. Exactly how long, you can't tell. Mere minutes? Hours? You could have been here for days, for all you know. Time is passing a little faster in your mind than you're at all comfortable with.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/626_april_saddened.gif[/img]

But what is it exactly that you're so distraught by? Sure, you said some truly horrible things in front of your best friends, but surely they won't dwell on it for that long. It's like everything else you say that could be mildly embarrassing. Your friends would forget it within the hour, but your mind will repeatedly return to that moment at late hours of the night while you're trying to sleep.

Surely your friends understand your moment of rage. Even the one that rage was directed at. They don't think any less of you. They're not scared of you. [color=#54da1f]He[/color] won't be hurt for long, if he was even hurt at all.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/627_april_seek.gif[/img]

You need to snap out of it. They're just words, after all. Just meaningless lines of pink text on a screen. Nothing more. 

Yet you can't shake away the daunting implications of your own words. They've haunted you non-stop for however long you've been in this corner. You have to ask yourself the question:

Do you really know yourself that well?

...You really shouldn't let yourself think about these existential topics right now, when there's shit that will need doing real soon. You need to calm yourself down. Maybe then, you can rest for a moment while your mood improves. You'll need to be in higher spirits later, when it comes time for you to play the game.

p.c: April: Find something to calm yourself.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/628_april_purifier.gif[/img]

You slowly rise from your fetal position in the corner and stumble to the other side of the room. Maybe you could draw something fun and happy? Maybe you could try playing another song on your guitar? 

Hmm... no. You don't have the energy. Looking at the picture of your mother, you consider perhaps seeking her out, but you really don't want to trouble her with these particular issues. It's probably best for the both of you to keep her out of the loop for the moment.

Now, this music box... its serene tune would work wonders for you right now. You guess you can just turn it on, and just kinda... lay here for a while. Maybe text somebody. 

But who will you text? You don't know if you want to bother any of them right now. You're not ready, and you're not sure if they're ready to talk to you either. Except maybe Ashley. She wasn't in the group chat when you said those things, but you have very little doubt she didn't hear about what happened. But you can still trust her, more than the others. She was your first real friend, after all. Your best friend.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/629_april_musicbox.gif[/img]

You open the music box, and its inner mechanisms begin creaking to life. A small angelic figure stands idly in the middle of the box, waiting for the music to start so that it can begin its slow and methodical spinning dance.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/631_april_ashleyboom.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/632_april_greenhouseboom.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/633_april_roomboom.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/634_april_ash.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/634_2_april_window.gif[/img]

A massive pillar of smoke rises from where your best friend's house once stood, obstructing your view of the area. 

You don't know how to feel about this. You don't know if you should feel relieved and excited, or overwhelmed by dread. Normally, the sight of your friend's house being crushed violently by a meteor should bring only negative feelings. But this is Sburb. And Sburb is weird. 

You guess you should check your laptop and see if Ashley's online. That should answer your question as to whether or not she's okay.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/635_april_laptop.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/635_2_april_screen.gif[/img]

You hastily check your laptop.

Ashley's online! That means she made it into the Medium successfully! You silently cheer and congratulate her. You'll actually talk to her later. There's someone else that will probably need your attention a hell of a lot more right about now. Your mother doesn't know what's going on, and you think it's time to explain what's going on to her before she freaks out too badly.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/636_april_lappytake.gif[/img]

You get up and take your laptop, and begin formulating the explanation you'll deliver to your mom.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/637_april_hallway.gif[/img]

You are now in the hallway, and quickly turn to face your living room.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/638_april_livingroomenter.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/638_2_april_livingroom.gif[/img]

You are now in your living room. The floor is littered with your more unique toys and trinkets, and the walls are covered in pictures. But there's no time for closely examining random objects right now. The time for that will come in a moment. For now though, calming your mother takes priority.

Your mother is on the other side of the room. She turns to face you as soon as you enter. She appears to have been looking out the window of the front door. You're certain she's aware of the area around Ashley's house now only housing nothing more than a flaming meteor. 

This may take some real explaining...

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/639_april_momshoo.gif[/img]

You try to approach your mother. She seems to think you're trying to go outside, and blocks your path accordingly. She tells you to just go back to your room and to perhaps turn on your music box again. 

She tries to sound gleeful and energetic, but you can easily tell she's incredibly panicked.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/640_april_momwalk.gif[/img]

You decide the best approach to take here is to ask your mother to take a seat on the couch. You take her by the hand and lead her there. She follows your request.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/641_april_momcomfort.gif[/img]

You continue holding her hand, and you try to look as optimistic and lively as possible to hopefully calm her down a little. 

And then, you tell her. You tell her about Sburb, and its effects on the real world. You tell her about the session you and your friends are playing in. You tell her that it's all going to be okay.

You tell her that Ashley is alive and well, in the Medium. You know this, because you saw her online on Pesterchum. You tell her that your friends, most of whom have also been hit by meteors, are also alive. You've talked to them after they've entered. You tell her that you'll enter soon, too. That you will be okay. You will both be okay.

Your mother is in shock. She is having a hard time believing this story. But she ultimately chooses to believe in it.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/642_april_momcalmed.gif[/img]

You jump off the couch, happy to see that your mother is now convinced. She permits you to go outside, if you'll promise to stay safe. You accept these conditions.

Before you go outside, though, you think you want to explore a little bit. You're having that weird urge again to just examine stuff in the room for no real reason.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/643_april_toys.gif[/img]

As was previously mentioned, you keep some of your more unique toys out here. You like to mess around with them every now and then while you're watching TV. You've tried to get Ashley interested in this toy collection a couple of times, but she's never really liked playing with toys. She does seem oddly transfixed to that pink angel doll, though.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/644_april_wallphotos.gif[/img]

A wall of photographs, both new and old. From left to right:

There's a picture of you out in the woods, from a few years back. You might've been going hiking that day with your mother, but you're not too sure. You like exploring those woods. They're very calm and serene. 

There's a baby picture of you, from what you believe to be a few months after you were born. You think it looks incredibly cute. Your mother agrees that it is one of the cutest pictures she's taken of you as a baby. Apparently baby-you was pretty misbehaved, so it wasn't often that she'd find you doing something this cute and innocent. She likes to tease you with that fact sometimes.

The next picture is of your mother, out on a dock, wearing a fancy dress and holding some flowers. It was supposedly taken about a year or so before you were born. You're not entirely sure where this photo was taken, but according to your mother, it was taken after the wedding of a couple of her old friends.

The final picture is fairly recent, being taken only a few weeks ago during one of Ashley's visits. She's very camera-shy, and basically refused to look directly at the camera, but you think it came out great nonetheless.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/645_april_momphoto.gif[/img]

You move to the back of the living room. There's another photo here.

This photo is of your mother, at around the age of 16. She looks strikingly similar to you in this picture. You bet if you let your hair down and wore that shirt, you'd be an exact match. She might still have that shirt somewhere. Your mother sees you examining the picture, and finds the similarity amusing. 

To the left of the photograph is your bathroom, and to the right is your mother's room. You don't feel like you need to enter either at the moment.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/646_april_rug.gif[/img]

You move back to the front of the room to examine the rug on the floor. It was custom-made by you, your mother and Ashley a while back. You love how bright and vibrant it looks.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/647_april_kitchen.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/647_2_april_kitchen.gif[/img]

To the right of the living room is the kitchen. The counter-top is still a little dirty from the last time you baked something, but the kitchen is otherwise spotless.

There's another door which leads to a pantry. You don't need to go in there either right now. No time for baking or snacking when there's meteors to evade.

p.c: April: Get ready to leave house.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/648_april_mombye.gif[/img]

You think you're done exploring for now. You proceed towards the door. Your mother asks for reassurance that you'll be safe out there. You promise her that you'll be fine. You'll be back in a moment.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/649_april_outside.gif[/img]

You are now outside, on your front porch.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/650_april_flowers.gif[/img]

The front of the house seemed just a little too boring to you, so you took some flowers from your greenhouse to line the porch with an extra splash of color. It's not much, but it works well enough, you think.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/651_april_windmill.gif[/img]

Your front yard, if you can even call it that, houses nothing more than a deactivated wind turbine. You're not completely sure why this is here. It was decommissioned since long before you were born.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/652_april_brokehouse.gif[/img]

You move to the back of your house to find your greenhouse has shattered! This is truly a tragedy, but it was one you almost expected to happen in these extraordinary times. 

You don't think you would've used it much after entering the Medium, anyway. Still though, you can't help but feel saddened by this.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/653_april_meteorsee.gif[/img]

You look across at where Ashley's house once stood. The smoke surrounding the meteor has subsided slightly, allowing you to see the igneous rock itself.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/654_april_meteorloop.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/654_2_april_meteorinspect.gif[/img]

You approach the meteor. You can't help but feel entranced by its radiant surface.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/655_april_meteorheat.gif[/img]

You stretch your arm towards the light. It radiates a comforting warmth. Then you pull your arm away, because that comforting warmth became a whole lot less comforting, and a whole lot more warm. 

That's the last time you'll let yourself become hypnotized by a meteor.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/656_april_laptopdrop.gif[/img]

You decide to sit next to the meteor anyway. The warmth is quite nice when you're not so close.

You try to take out your laptop, but your PRESENT MODUS instead gives you back your Squiddle plush. You waste no time in re-captchaloging the plush toy, and make another attempt at retrieving your laptop. 

Second time's the charm.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/657_april_distance2.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/657_2_april_presentday.gif[/img]

[url=https://mspfa.com/?s=24551&p=530]You then proceed to have another conversation we've heard before, about 100 pages ago.[/url]

And thus, we have returned to the present time. You think you'll try to contact Ryan now, so that you can get into the game as soon as possible. From your point of view, that is exactly what happens next. But, I think we should take a break from being April for now. 

Hmmm. I wonder what Jeff is up to?
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/658_jeff_mineelevator.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/659_jeff_reveal.gif[/img]

You are now Jeff. You have just ventured into a mineshaft. Rocks and gold litter the room, and many of the doorways are blocked off. A platform is waiting next to you. What will you do?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/660_jeff_gold.gif[/img]

You pick up a loose nugget of gold laying next to the platform. You're not quite sure what you'll do with this, but it'll be cool to have nonetheless. Maybe you'll use this in an alchemy session later.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/661_jeff_elevatorstep.gif[/img]

The platform creaks and jostles under your weight as you step onto it. There are two buttons for you to press, pointing up and down.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/662_jeff_elevatorpress.gif[/img]

You press the button pointing down.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/663_jeff_elevatordescend.gif[/img]

The platform lets out a metallic clang and begins descending into the depths below.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/665_jeff_vista.gif[/img]

As you descend, a large cavern comes into view. Mining equipment is scattered around the area, with a massive vault blocking off the end of the cavern.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/666.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/667_jeff_land.gif[/img]

You find yourself mesmerized by the size of the cavern and the vault as you touch down on the ground.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/668_jeff_caverns.gif[/img]

You step off of the elevator platform.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/669_jeff_pickget.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/669_jeff_pickget_text.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/670_jeff_pick.gif[/img]

You take the pickaxe in an admittedly over-dramatic fashion for no explicable reason. You think you'll just hold onto this, rather than captchaloguing it and having to waste time and ammo later retrieving it from your Target Practice modus.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/671_jeff_vaultexamine.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/671_2_jeff_vaultexamine.gif[/img]

You walk to the other side of the cavern and examine the extravagant vault towering above you.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/672_jeff_vaultsymbols.gif[/img]

The vault includes a ring on its surface, bearing symbols you recognize. These are Sburb's aspects. You're not sure what they represent here on this vault, if anything. Though, there is one part of this ring that strikes you as being.. especially interesting.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/673_jeff_sorryaspecttheorycrafters.gif[/img]

Among the aspects are symbols you don't recognize at all. The meanings behind them completely evade you. Are these aspects new to this edition of Sburb? Do they symbolize something completely different? Only time will tell, but you feel a slight sense of giddiness at the implications of this.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/674_jeff_lever.gif[/img]

You pull a lever to the side that is connected to the vault. Nothing seems to happen.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/675_jeff_vaultmine.gif[/img]

You didn't think this would do anything, but you might as well try putting this pickaxe to use. As per your expectations, the pickaxe does nothing but bounce off the vault door.

p.c: Jeff: Examine the symbol of Breath.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/676_jeff_vaultclose.gif[/img]

You fly up to the top of the vault door, where the symbol of Breath appears on the ring. You are the Knight of Breath, after all. Perhaps you should take a closer look at it.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/677_jeff_vaultglow.gif[/img]

You hold your hand up to the symbol. It begins to glow and emits a low, quiet hum.

Perhaps.. it's time to try something.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/678_jeff_concentrate.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/678_2_jeff_eyeclose.gif[/img]

You close your eyes, hold out your hand, and begin to concentrate.

The air around you grows ever so slightly thicker.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/679_jeff_summoning.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/680_jeff_breath.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/681_jeff_activate.gif[/img]

The air coils around your hand and reaches into the symbol of Breath. The symbol lights up even more. The low hum begins to grow in pitch and volume.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/682_jeff_shock.gif[/img]

You... honestly didn't think that would work.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/683_jeff_lightup.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/684_jeff_litvault.gif[/img]

The symbols on the vault remain darkened as the ring itself lights up. You think you just unlocked it, yet it still hasn't opened. Maybe you should try the lever again?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/685_jeff_lever2.gif[/img]

You pull the lever again...

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/686_jeff_vaultopen.gif[/img]

The vault lets out a loud metallic clanging as it begins to rise out of its place. Success!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/687_jeff_vaultsilhouette.gif[/img]

You look into the vault's opening. Nothing but darkness, from what you can see out here.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/688_jeff_darkness.gif[/img]

You enter the vault. The darkness stretches an indeterminate distance in front of you. Only the soft echoes of your own footsteps can be heard.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/689_jeff_light.gif[/img]

You reach a corner and spot a light in the distance.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/690_jeff_fireplace.gif[/img]

Upon further inspection, you find what appears to be a campfire, quietly crackling in the middle of the dark room.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/691_jeff_firelook.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/692_jeff_whatsthat.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/693_jeff_boonies.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/816_t_blackout.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/817_t_anger.gif[/img]

Hey, at least you follow SOME kind of command. The rage builds within you and the urge to punch something grows stronger.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/818_t_hole.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/819_t_lights.gif[/img]

The power to your residence turns back on and your laptop begins restarting. Now, would you kindly go stand by your door so I can properly introduce you? Thanks.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/820_ah_intro.gif[/img]

Very good. Now let's give you a name, shall we? Time to bring back our old friend, the name prompt.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/821_ah_name.gif[/img]

You enter a rather insulting name and the prompt.. accepts it? Oh. Huh. I guess your name's Asshole Fuckerass now.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/822_ah_roomexamine.gif[/img]

Your name is ASSHOLE FUCKERASS (apparently). Your interests include BEING A DICK and WATCHING HENTAI. You're also a fan of BLAZING IT UP and SMOKING DAT 'URB. You also regularly- oh will you settle down there?? I'm trying to do your intro.

Fine, let me try something else then.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/823_ah_roomexamine_betterquality.gif[/img]

I told you this would happen. Now, if you don't behave, you'll be stuck in this art style forever.

Okay. Good. I'm going to introduce you properly now.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/824_tim_roomexamine.gif[/img]

Your real name is TIM CLAIRE. You have a deep love for the act of TROLLING and general DOUCHEBAGGERY. Despite that, you consider yourself a NICE GUY. Others will agree, however they wouldn't mean it in the same way you think they do.

You're an avid GAMER. All games, all the time. Among your favorites are the CALL OF DUTY series and FORTNITE. 

Speaking of which, you aspire to be a STREAMER, or failing that, an INFLUENCER of some kind. It is your DREAM to play games for a living and you envy those that do already. You crave ATTENTION, and you will attain it by any means necessary. 

What will you do now?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/825_tim_deskexamine.gif[/img]

This is where you spend every minute of every day, sitting at your desk on your LAPTOP. The laptop itself is nothing special. You're hoping to upgrade it when you get the chance. It works well enough for now though.

You also have an old FIDGET SPINNER here. For fidgeting. And a bag of DORITOS. For eating.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/826_tim_wallexamine.gif[/img]

You look at the furthest wall of your room. This is your designated PUNCH WALL. For punching. You regularly come over to this wall to relieve your anger and stress. That last punch you did created a sizeable hole in the wall. 

You also have posters for CALL OF DUTY BLACK OPS 4, FORTNITE and BATTLEFIELD up here. The real good shit.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/827_tim_closet.gif[/img]

There's not much in your closet, besides extra clothes. There's also a BOX in the back. You can't remember what was in it.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/828_tim_window.gif[/img]

The view outside is admittedly incredible, especially for how small this apartment is. Despite the big-ass building in the way, you've got a good view of the sunset behind a neat city skyline.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/829_tim_bedwall.gif[/img]

You examine the other wall. More posters for the various games you play. COUNTER-STRIKE: GLOBAL OFFENSIVE, RAINBOW SIX: SIEGE and WORLD OF TANKS. 

You also have some DIGITAL ITEMS on your dresser, as well as a LAVA LAMP. Man, lava lamps look so cool. You kind of wish you could get more.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/830_tim_phonetake.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/830_2_tim_modus.gif[/img]

You captchalogue your PHONE in your INSULT MODUS. You never know when one of your friends are gonna need you for some dumb game you have no interest in. 

Speaking of your modus, you absolutely love this thing. Trying to retrieve an item will prompt a battle of insults to occur. It helps you to sharpen your roasts.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/831_tim_initiate.gif[/img]

ALLOW YOU TO DEMONSTRATE.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/832_tim_battle.gif[/img]

Both you and your opponent are at FULL HEALTH. It is YOUR TURN TO INSULT.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/833_tim_roast.gif[/img]

You deliver one of your FINEST ROASTS. The opponent takes FATAL DAMAGE!

The opponent collapses. Your item can now be properly retrieved. 

...You may have bought a hacked modus to allow any insult to instantly defeat your opponent, but you will keep telling yourself your ROASTS are SAVAGE to make yourself feel better.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/834_tim_ohno.gif[/img]

The item you were trying to retrieve is dropped at your feet. Ah yes. A classic. One of the only kinds of literature worth reading.

You quickly re-captchalogue the item. You'll read it later.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/835_2_tim_box.gif[/img]

You tuck it away into your STRIFE DECK.

p.c: April: Throw a Cruxite Dowel into the Kernelsprite.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/851_april_totemtype.gif[/img]

You admit, the idea of a Cruxite Sprite does sound interesting... but you don't think you want to do that. Bringing a character you designed to life appeals to you quite a bit more, and so you think you'll go do that instead.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/852_april_room.gif[/img]

You exit the greenhouse and immediately enter your room. The Kernelsprite follows closely behind, eager to receive its first prototyping.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/853_april_drawing.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/853_2_april_flower.gif[/img]

You spend about a minute drawing your TROLLSONA. You've given her a simple, yet fitting name and quirk. 

Her name is FLOWER FRIEND, and she [color=#a00103]:speaks in a constantly :Delighted manner!)[/color]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/854_april_prototype.gif[/img]

You hold your drawing out in front of you, and the Kernelsprite gently floats into it.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/855_april_protosuccess.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/856_april_spritefriend.gif[/img]

Success! Your KERNELSPRITE has been prototyped with FLOWER FRIEND, becoming FLOWERSPRITE!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/857_april_astonish.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/857_2_april_flowerreact.gif[/img]

You stare at Flowersprite in complete admiration... Your own beautiful troll character, immediately made into a real, living being. She stares back at you, happily and seemingly thankful despite the inability to speak as of now. 

You want to hug her, but you just can't risk prototyping yourself. This restriction makes you sad. Maybe one day, but for now, you can only gaze longingly at her.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/858_april_return.gif[/img]

Yes. There are more important things to be doing right now, and those things happen to be keeping yourself and your loved ones alive by getting the hell off of this planet before the meteors drop. You'll have time for staring later.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/859_april_pot.gif[/img]

You spend about another minute doing that off-screen because we should all know how this stuff works by now. At the end of the process, the Alchemiter produces an empty pot.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act3/860_april_potexamine.gif[/img]

You look at the pot. Well, the solution to this should be easy; growing stuff is practically second nature to you. Though, you can't help but feel concerned. What if you need to grow a specific kind of plant that is unknown to you? How long will it take for this thing to grow? You only have about 20 minutes on the clock, and plants take quite a bit longer to mature.

Maybe you're overthinking things, but the game of Sburb is a very unforgiving one. There's really no time for this though. Plant first, concern later.
