You are now THIS GUY.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/949_gambit_name_new.gif[/img]

Name? You have no name, and you would quite prefer it if you never had one. Names are overrated, anyway. What even are names? Just unique words used to identify yourself with no underlying meaning? That seems silly. Names don't describe who you are, or what you do. No, you would much rather identify with a title more meaningful. For example, a rank.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/950_gambit_rank_new.gif[/img]

Much better.

You are the GAMBIT. Because to your very unique carapace, it is your job to rush directly into the ARMY OF LIGHT and take out as many of their pawns as possible. Or, it WAS your job. Your death would be practically guaranteed once the bigger pieces start rolling in, and because of that, you kind of STOPPED GIVING A SHIT ABOUT YOUR JOB. These were the orders of your KING, and disobeying him would surely lead to a GRUESOME and BLOODY END. 

That is why you are abandoning the war entirely. You won't allow your KING and QUEEN to take advantage of you so thoughtlessly. If you go down, it won't be for them or their army. You'll kill them both later, mark your goddamn words. But for now, you need to get off this battlefield.

p.c: Hey, why DO you look so weird, anyway?
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/951_gambit_augment.gif[/img]

If you must know, it's all actually quite simple. You have received MANY AUGMENTATIONS and MUTATIONS, most of which are in their EARLY PROTOTYPE STAGES. You are, in a sense, an EXPERIMENT. Thanks to these modifications, you have been granted IMMENSE STRENGTH and AGILITY. You have the power to completely turn the tide of battle single-handedly. You are the ultimate pawn killer.

Thankfully, the KING's not very bright, otherwise he would've thought twice before wanting to send the overpowered soldier to his assured doom. That being said, you're still not ready to take him or the Queen on. Not with their prototypings, anyway. You'll need to find some better gear.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/952_gambit_area.gif[/img]

You've looked around most of the immediate area already. Nothing too important up here, besides the battle that has recently begun over the hill in front of you. You could probably just pick a direction and start walking until you reach something of interest.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/953_gambit_distantcastle.gif[/img]

To your left and in the distance lies one of the largest Dersite castles on the battlefield. You'll find some good gear there for sure, but you might run into trouble if some soldiers were to exit it. Nothing you can't handle, of course. It would be more of a mild inconvenience, if anything.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/954_gambit_farmland.gif[/img]

Meanwhile, to the right, you find nothing but farmland and distant huts belonging to some farmers. You most likely won't find much of use this way, but the chances of being spotted by the soldiers would be slim to none. You'd surely be spotted by the farmers though, but they don't care about those who abandon the war. You don't care about them either. You doubt they'd ever be useful to you or important to any kind of story.

Clearly, this isn't a hard choice to make. The pros outweigh the cons if you go to the castle, and vice versa if you explore the farmlands.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/955_gambit_walk.gif[/img]

You begin your great journey along the empty hillside towards the castle. The battle continues to rage on nearby. Thankfully, the only soldiers in this particular district for now are pawns. It'd be a bit more of an inconvenience if a knight was to show up here. You should pick up the pace a little bit before they actually do arrive.

About 10 minutes of uneventful walking pass before something happens.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/956_gambit_soldiers.gif[/img]

You are suddenly approached by a small group of soldiers. The one leading the charge eyes you angrily and wonders where the hell you think you're going. You say you need some gear from the castle. He asks why don't you have it on you? You say you were low on time and forgot to bring something. Silly you. He says well, what are you missing, you look like you have everything. You say your shit. He says yeah, what shit. You say no, you mean, your shit. As in, the shit you need to give about your orders. You don't have the shit. He says he doesn't quite understand. You say you can do it, champ. He says he doesn't like your tone.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/957_gambit_kill.gif[/img]

You immediately stop giving a shit about this conversation as well.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/958_gambit_rook.gif[/img]

Oh great. Now there's a rook here. Looks like they're starting to roll out the bigger guns already. 

These guys are pretty dumb. You think you can talk your way past him. You repeat to him what you told the last guy. He growls in a way that implies he doesn't believe you. Right, most of them can't talk properly. He looks like he wants to know why you killed those friendly pawns. You tell him they were double agents from the Prospitian army, trying to infiltrate your army. He looks confused and distrusting, as if he wants proof. Damn. Why did you have to run into the one rook out here with an actual brain?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/959_gambit_deadrook.gif[/img]

Well. That solves that problem.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/960_gambit_castleclose.gif[/img]

No point in hanging around here. You continue your walk to the castle, making sure to wipe the rook's blood off your face. Your journey goes mostly uninterrupted, with only the occasional pawn wondering where you're going, followed by you shoving a sword through their carapaces. No big deal.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/961_gambit_castlegate.gif[/img]

You finally reach the castle. Huh, no guards outside? Very strange, but you're not complaining. Not like it would matter, anyway. You could take them on any day.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/962_gambit_castlewindow.gif[/img]

You go inside the castle. Damn, this place is big. It'll take you a little while to get to the armory. Hm. More uneventful walking, huh? We don't have time for that kind of thing. This is an intermission, for gods sake. It should be short and sweet, so that we can get a taste of this delicious, delicious side-lore and then get back to the main story. You know, the one with the kids playing a super cool game and doing super cool stuff in said game. When are we gonna see them again? Never, at this rate. Speed it up a bit.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/963_gambit_pass.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/964_gambit_notice.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/965_967_969_gambit_meetingroom.gif[/img]

Ah.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/966_968_gambit_stare.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/965_967_969_gambit_meetingroom.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/966_968_gambit_stare.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/965_967_969_gambit_meetingroom.gif[/img]

One of the soldiers asks can they help you, they're kind of having a meeting.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/970_gambit_deceive.gif[/img]

You say you were looking for the armory. Someone says well, this isn't it. You say you can see that. Someone else mutters something you didn't quite hear and points to your sword. The first guy who spoke asks where the blood came from. You say it's Prospitian blood. He asks what are you doing back here, then? You try the same excuse you used outside. You then have roughly the same conversation as you did outside. They're not buying it. It seems your deception skills need some work.

p.c: Gambit: Just get on with it.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/971_gambit_slaughter.gif[/img]

The conversation predictably ends in roughly the same way as well. Yeah, you should just stop trying to talk your way out of these encounters. Your augmentations didn't include any enhanced social skills, and you have to admit, it's more fun this way.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/972_gambit_clean.gif[/img]

Wiping the blood off of your carapace is easy enough, but getting it out of your outfit is impossible without proper cleaning utilities. Looks like this thing is done for. Not a big deal, you wanted to get rid of this outfit at some point anyway.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/973_gambit_tear.gif[/img]

Soldier outfits look so much cooler when they're in tatters. Plus, no more blood on you. It's a win-win. 

You'll just leave the torn pieces of clothing here. You think that'll spice up the crime scene a little bit.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/974_gambit_leave.gif[/img]

Right. Your job is done here. The search for the armory continues.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/975_gambit_explore.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/975_2_gambit_explore.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/975_3_gambit_explore.gif[/img]

More walking, more nothing, yadda yadda, you get it already. You know the pattern well by now.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/976_gambit_changing.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/976_2_gambit_changing.gif[/img]

You suddenly happen upon a soldier who appears to be changing clothes. This is definitely the armory. Actually, it's more of a generic looking locker room, but people here call it the armory anyway.

The soldier spots you and stares at you for a minute. You deeply sigh and begin readying your weapon again, but he shrugs and looks away. He says yeah these outfits are real cheap pieces of shit aren't they. Wow, this guy thinks you're legit. And as soon as you decided you weren't gonna try to convince them anymore. You make a short noise of agreement with his statement.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/977_gambit_why.gif[/img]

Okay, now there was actually no reason to do that. Come on, that guy was cool. Well, whatever, now there's nobody around to see what's going on. 

You look at the open lockers. The one closest to you has a RIFLE, a BOW with a couple of ARROWS, and a BLUE HOODIE. The other one contains pretty much FUCK-ALL.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/978_gambit_hoodie.gif[/img]

You take and equip the BLUE HOODIE. A lot of people around here have been investing in these recently. You're not complaining, you quite like the look. You're not the biggest fan of the color though. Whatever, this'll do for now.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/979_gambit_weapons.gif[/img]

You take the BOW and an ARROW. You much prefer using melee weapons, but you've decided your old sword is gonna stay lodged in that guy's head. It was coming to the end of its days anyway, what with the amount of violent teamkilling you've just been doing. The bow and arrow will come in handy for if you somehow can't find another sword here. The arrow may also prove to be a fun one-time use melee weapon.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/980_gambit_lockers.gif[/img]

You keep looking through the armory. Not a lot of stuff useful to you here, strangely. There's a lot more old clothes than you were expecting. You did find a new sword though, that you promptly equip. You decide to keep the bow and arrow tucked away in your inventory, just in case.

p.c: Gambit: Take a few of those rifles.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/981alt_gambit_rifles.gif[/img]

You considered it. You're not really a gun fan though. Again, you much prefer melee, and with guns you don't even have an opportunity to stab someone with the ammo like you do with a bow and arrow. Maybe if one of them had a bayonet attached to it.

Not to mention, taking more than one rifle just sounds overkill. Then again, you like overkill. You spend a few more seconds considering the rifles.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/981_gambit_sylladex.gif[/img]

Sylladex? The hell's that? Is that supposed to be an inventory? What a dumb word. Just call it an inventory like everyone else, will ya? But fine, you will examine your inventory, which is really just what you call the collection of items you've somehow managed to cram into your pockets.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/982_gambit_inventory.gif[/img]

You don't have alot on you. Just a SWORD, a BOW, and ONE (1) ARROW. This is everything you've managed to find useful from the armory. Looking at all of this together really puts into perspective how pointless this journey was.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/983_gambit_badge.gif[/img]

You also have your BADGE in your inventory. You guess you'll keep holding onto this too, just as a memento. 

You used to have the same badge everyone else has, but someone eventually found there was a problem with that badge's design. Turns out, some buffoon printed the wrong number of Derse Towers on it. There's 6 towers, not 4. Whoever made the original badges got fired, and the new guy got lazy and just took the towers out of the design entirely. The new badges were rolled out to unique units such as yourself, but the standard pawns and such still use the original badge design. 

That story still makes you laugh. How stupid can one be?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/984_gambit_leaving.gif[/img]

You have to admit, you're quite disappointed with the outcome of this adventure. All that long and boring wandering for basically nothing. See, this is why nobody likes Intermissions, they never go anywhere or mean anything. You guess you'll just go back out to the battlefield and.. you don't know, pass the story back to some more interesting people?

If you remember correctly, there's a docking bay down this corridor. You can get back out to the battlefield that way.

...Wait.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/985_gambit_look.gif[/img]

What's that? 

No. No, they can't be serious.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/987_gambit_dropship.gif[/img]

There's still a fucking DROPSHIP in here??

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/988_gambit_preship.gif[/img]

You thought they deployed all of these already. Why wouldn't they? The battle is in full effect, why wouldn't they throw out everything they've got? Was that what the meeting earlier was about? Actually, fuck it, who cares about any of that, you have a fucking DROPSHIP.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/989_1_gambit_board.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/989_2_gambit_inside.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/989_3_gambit_cockpit.gif[/img]

Yes.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/990_1_gambit_button.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/990_2_gambit_rise.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/990_3_gambit_startup.gif[/img]

Hell yes.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/991_gambit_blastoff.gif[/img]

P.

FUCKING.

CHOOOOO.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/992_gambit_overhead.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/993_gambit_mobius.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/994_gambit_escape.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/994_2_gambit_cockpit.gif[/img]

You know exactly where you're going. The Dersites talked of this place in their prophesies. You usually don't believe in that shit, but hey, some of their prophesies have come true, it's worth a shot. And, if it is true, you'll have everything you need. Maybe the gear you got from Skaia was enough. You just need to put it all together.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/995_gambit_leave.gif[/img]

And so, you leave Skaia, and you fly to the prophesied place.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/996_gambit_distantveil.gif[/img]

A place beyond Skaia, between the planets of light and dark.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/997_gambit_ectometeor.gif[/img]

The place where the heroes were born.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/998_gambit_close.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/998_2_gambit_crash.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/999_gambit_crash.gif[/img]

Well, that was one way to enter the meteor lab. Your dropship suffered some damage. Unfortunately, a bit too much damage for it to be operational past this point. It got you to your destination though, and that's really all you could ask of it. Rest in peace, dearest dropship. You did well. 

Now, time to investigate the place.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1000_gambit_hall.gif[/img]

You celebrate hitting the 1000 page milestone of this adventure in the most mundane way possible, by walking down yet another bland corridor. Truly, this is the way to do it. We've hit a peak few others could hope to reach. Those watching from the outside look upon us in stunned admiration, muttering to themselves "they've got something the rest of us don't." And that, we do. We know how to write an intermission, and we know how to fuckin' celebrate a milestone. Tremble before us, lowly outsiders, for it does not get any better than this.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1001_gambit_transportalizer.gif[/img]

Your thoughts are interrupted by the sudden appearance of a TRANSPORTALIZER. Well, you might as well just jump straight on it. Not like there's anything else going on in this hallway.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1002_gambit_tp.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1003_gambit_lab.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1004_gambit_screens.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1004_2_gambit_screens.gif[/img]

Hmm. You're not really seeing the thing you need here. There's some other kinds of machinery though, perhaps you could take a look at them while you're here.

You take a particular interest in the 3 machines to the left, each with two monitors on them.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1005_gambit_ryan.gif[/img]

Who's this kid? One of the heroes, maybe? He doesn't much look like a hero. He's not doing anything heroic either, just kinda blankly staring at something off-screen. Boring.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1006_gambit_jeff.gif[/img]

You press a button and the other screen switches on. Now this kid looks a bit more heroic, all flying around and stuff. ..Still boring, though. 

Eh, these just seem to be machines for viewing the heroes. You can't really find yourself caring much about whatever they're up to. You'll go look somewhere else.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1007_2_gambit_alchemylab.gif[/img]

You soon happen upon a room that seems to be filled with ALCHEMITERS. Hell yes, exactly what you needed. Now, what to do with these?

...Hang on a second, what's over there?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1008_gambit_gear.gif[/img]

In the corner of the room lies a face plate of sorts and some other kind of device. Surrounding them are totems, some strange looking cards, and a case of something else. There's also a note on the ground.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1009_gambit_emnote.gif[/img]

"i got your note. i really shouldn't be giving this back to you, but because you decided time-related bullshit has to be involved, i guess now i have to. well, perhaps you could consider it a favor for bringing us what we needed to get out of here. just take it. do what you gotta do with it. that's all."

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1010_gambit_notestare.gif[/img]

You have no idea what this means. 

Well, it's probably not directed at you. You think you just accidentally intercepted some kind of shady deal. This is your shit now, you declare. You're certainly not one to turn down a deus ex machina.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1011_gambit_casefront.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1011_2_gambit_gristcase.gif[/img]

You open the case. This appears to be GRIST, a sort of material used in alchemy. Only the heroes can properly collect these, but you guess you could just throw this into an Alchemiter to make stuff.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1012_gambit_card.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1012_2_gambit_machines.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1012_3_gambit_machines.gif[/img]

There's some cards here as well. They're all blank. You see the word "captchalogue" written along the side of each card. No clue what that means. You also spy some other machinery in the corner with some card slots in them. Those'll probably come in handy later.

You quickly spend a moment figuring out how this shit works, but you do it all off-screen because we don't have the time or patience to watch this tomfoolery much longer.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1013_gambit_bomb.gif[/img]

You're not entirely sure what this is. There appears to be a digital screen on the front.. a bunch of wires hanging out.. an oddly thick frame..

Okay, this is either a really fancy digital alarm clock, or else some kind of explosive device. You like the sound of the latter.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1014_gambit_mask.gif[/img]

This is a unique mask. Its front looks to be entirely digital. Looks like a perfect size for you, too. You'll play dress-up with it in a moment though, you've got some alchemizing to do.

p.c: Gambit: Combine Blue Hoodie && Digital Mask
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1015_gambit_deveil.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1015_2_gambit_deveil.gif[/img]

You make the DEVEIL. 

You must admit, you're a bit disappointed with its appearance. It just kind of.. turned the hoodie gray. On the bright side though, the hoodie appears to have amplified your strength and agility. You move faster and with more force than you think you are. Not bad at all.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1016_gambit_csword.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1016_2_gambit_csword.gif[/img]

You make the CYBER SABER.

Not a big visual upgrade again, but you're cool with it. You assume this thing has, like the hoodie, some kind of amplified power. Nice.

You've got the basics down. Maybe now's a good time to try on that mask just for fun before you get into the bonus stuff.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1017_gambit_maskequip.gif[/img]

You're not quite sure how you're gonna see out of this thing, but it's here, you might as well just try it on for a second.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1018_gambit_maskactivate.gif[/img]

Hang on, what's happening?

The mask begins vibrating. Quite violently, too. Shit, you can't take it off. This isn't good.


[size=10]Warning: Flashing imagery on next page.[/size]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1019_gambit_activating.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1019_2_gambit_flash.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1019_3_gambit_eyes.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1020_gambit_transform.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1021_gambit_fallen.gif[/img]

The mask calms down. The pain begins to subside.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1022_gambit_rise.gif[/img]

You can see again. Not through your eyes, but through the digital face plate. You can feel the energy rushing through your body. Your already amplified power, now boosted further. 

You can't help but let out a light chuckle at these circumstances.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1023_gambit_mask.gif[/img]

You are the GAMBIT.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1024_truegambit.gif[/img]

And you swear, very soon, you are going to KILL THEM ALL, and you are going to SMILE as you watch them all die.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1025_derse.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1026_derseclose.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1027_dersetowers.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1028_bq_eye.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1029_bqueen.gif[/img]

You are now the BLACK QUEEN.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1030_bq_guard.gif[/img]

One of your SENTRIES has just reported a call he received from a soldier down on SKAIA. It was absolutely not the kind of news you wanted to hear, yet it was one you could easily see coming from a mile away.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1031_bq_gambit.gif[/img]

The GAMBIT has escaped.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1032_bq_facepalm.gif[/img]

Goddamn that King. You told him not to make that soldier into a gambit, but he did it anyway. No matter how many times you reminded him how big of a threat that soldier would be if he were to escape, the King just would not listen. Now, you're all officially fucked. 

You're not throwing in the towel just yet though. He's overpowered, but he's sure as hell not invincible. You've got some calls to make.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1033_bq_sscall.gif[/img]

The Archagent and yourself aren't on very good terms, but you hope he's got at least some sense in him to listen. He's just as much in danger as everyone else.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1034_bq_ss.gif[/img]

You tell him to pick up. He doesn't answer. You tell him again to pick up. You hear his walkie-talkie begin transmitting, but it stops before he says anything. You say Archagent, for fucks sake, what are you doing. You hear fumbling on his end, then a voice hissing at him to answer. He says what the hell do you want, he's busy. You say finally. You have a very important job for him and he needs to listen carefully. He sighs and says what is it. You tell him the Gambit is loose. He says the what? You ask how the fuck doesn't he know who the Gambit is, he's been briefed on this countless times. He says do you really think he listens to your briefings, half the stuff you spout is complete nonsense. 

This lousy excuse for an archagent... Typically you'd send someone to clock him across the face when he gives you this kind of attitude, or you'd head out and do it yourself. But there really is no time today. No time for clocking (ironically enough), and no time for attitude. You tell him this. He says he doesn't care about no Gambit, he's got more important matters to attend to right now. You ask what possibly could be more important than this? He says, for starters, the Draconian Dignitary has reported the Knight has woken up and has fled Derse, so he has to investigate the matter and file the appropriate paperwork. You say you'll give a lower ranking agent the hero monitoring duties, but you need him and his agents on high alert. He goes quiet for a moment then says fine. Over and out.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1035_bq_postss.gif[/img]

You'll handle the Knight situation later. Sure, that is an important matter, but you prioritize your own safety over public image. Prospit can revel in their one-upmanship just a little longer in the "awoken heroes" department. Right now, you need to schedule a meeting. It's not the kind of person you want to meet with, but you can't say they won't be a huge help if you can reason with them.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1036_bq_seat.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1036_2_bq_secret.gif[/img]

The particular person you had in mind can't be contacted through a standard radio. You need one specifically tied to theirs. That very radio happens to be hidden away inside the seat of your throne.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1037_bq_contact.gif[/img]

You radio your contact. They're hesitant, but ultimately agree to an in-person meeting. In the meantime, you make your way out of the throne room, towards a shuttle stationed close by.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1038_bq_bridge.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1038_2_bq_hall.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1038_3_bq_shipyard.gif[/img]

You walk through the maze of hallways and bridges that is the Derse capital before finally finding yourself in the shipyard. A lone shuttle is waiting, as is who you assume is your pilot.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1039_bq_pilot.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1039_2_bq_shuttle.gif[/img]

The pilot salutes you as you approach the shuttle. You don't pay him any mind. He follows you into the shuttle and starts it up as you take a seat.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1040_bq_blastoff.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1040_2_bq_derseleave.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1040_3_bq_distant.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1040_4_bq_skaia.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1040_5_bq_prospit.gif[/img]

Your next destination:

PROSPIT.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1041_bq_landing.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1041_2_bq_land.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1042_bq_reg.gif[/img]

You exit the shuttle. A pair of AUTHORITY REGULATORS approach you, saying they'll need to escort you to your destination. You don't bother with a response, you've got business to attend to. The pilot decides to stay behind.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1043_bq_carpet.gif[/img]

You come to a familiar regal looking red carpet. This is the place.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1044_bq_distantqueen.gif[/img]

And there she is. Your equal. The brains behind the entire enemy army. Someone who, as much as you hate to admit it, you need on your side to fight against a mutual and near invincible enemy.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1045_wq.gif[/img]

The WHITE QUEEN.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1046_bq_ring.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1046_2_bq_wq.gif[/img]

As a show of trust and respect, you remove your ring, nullifying your prototypings. The White Queen thanks you for this decision, and dismisses the Authority Regulators behind you.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1047_wq_ring.gif[/img]

The White Queen also decides to remove her ring.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1048_bq_wq_discuss.gif[/img]

You both discuss the situation. You tell her of the Gambit, a mutated and augmented soldier from your army. He was originally being used as an experiment for these augmentations, but upon seeing his incredible power, your KING made him into a soldier. A soldier who would rush directly into the army of light, kill as many of them as possible, and die at their hands. You tried to argue against this decision, but you couldn't. The Gambit has now escaped the battlefield and his whereabouts are currently unknown. 

That is why you have arranged this meeting. You admit to her that you need not just her help, but the help of her army also. The Gambit is a huge threat to everyone. For this reason, you wish to declare a temporary CEASEFIRE between the Armies of Light and Darkness while the Gambit is dealt with.

The White Queen ponders your request for a moment. She reveals similar experiments were being conducted on Prospit, and thus understands the risks well. She was, thankfully, able to convince the WHITE KING to halt these experiments before any kind of similar super-soldier was created. She fully recognizes the danger everyone is in, and so, she agrees that a ceasefire must be declared.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1049_bq_wq_ceasefire.gif[/img]

Thus, a ceasefire is declared between PROSPIT and DERSE, uniting the two once opposing armies, even if for only a few short hours.

p.c: BQ and WQ: Return to shuttle.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1050_bq_wq_shuttle.gif[/img]

You return to your shuttle, with the White Queen in tow. You'll both need to head down to the battlefield next to meet with your respective KINGS.

The pilot from earlier greets you again. He doesn't acknowledge the White Queen.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1051_bqwq_blastoff.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1051_2_bqwq_enter.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1051_3_bqwq_skaia.gif[/img]

Your next destination:

SKAIA.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1052_bqwq_landing.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1052_2_bqwq_land.gif[/img]

...You really wish he'd stop landing so hard.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1053_bqwq_skaiashuttle.gif[/img]

You both exit the shuttle. The White Queen suggests you put your ring back on before you go talk to the King, just in case you're attacked by a Prospitian squad before the ceasefire is officially called.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1054_bqwq_reproto.gif[/img]

You take the White Queen's advice. Your prototypings return. The White Queen does the same. 

You then decide you're not going to waste any time in delivering the news to the Black King. The White Queen agrees, and decides she will go talk to the White King alone. She bids you farewell, and starts on her way.

p.c: BQ: Go talk to the BLACK KING.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1055_bq_distantking.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1055_2_bq_pilot.gif[/img]

You're about to leave as well when the pilot appears in the doorway of the shuttle, wondering what he's supposed to do now. You tell him you don't care, he can do whatever the hell he wants. He asks if he can tag along. You sigh and turn away. He seems to take this as a yes.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1056_bq_walk.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1056_2_bq_bkfoot.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1056_3_bq_king.gif[/img]

You walk along the battlefield, finally reaching the BLACK KING. He spots you and looks down at you with a confused expression on his face. He wants to know what you're doing out here.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1057_bq_bk.gif[/img]

You tell him to switch his scepter off for a moment so you can speak with him properly. He complies, and repeats his earlier question. 

You explain to him that the super overpowered soldier he tried to send out to his death has escaped, as per your predictions. The Black King looks pissed, and vows to kill the Gambit once the Prospitian Army is dealt with. You tell him that's the main thing you wanted to discuss. You've spoken to the White Queen and have organized a temporary ceasefire in order to manage this Gambit problem. The White Queen is currently relaying this same information to the White King. 

The Black King thinks about this for a second. He doesn't much care for allying with his enemy, but having an entire other army to help eliminate the Gambit? At the very least, he's intrigued.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1058_bq_bkgrow.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1058_2_bk_cease.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1058_3_pawns.gif[/img]

The Black King finally decides to accept the ceasefire.

He reactivates his scepter and grows in size again, and loudly announces the ceasefire. You see Black and White pawns nearby breaking their fights up and lowering their weapons. In the distance, you hear the White King relaying the same announcement.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1059_bq_bk_pawns.gif[/img]

A bunch of pawns approach you and the Black King to ask what the matter is. You tell them to hang onto their gear, they've still got a job to do. There's a rogue super-soldier that needs to be eliminated, and you're going to need as many numbers as possible.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1060_reunion.gif[/img]

The White Queen approaches you, alongside the White King and another large gathering of soldiers. The two Kings eye each other, though it's mostly the Black King doing the aggressive kind of eyeing. The White Queen reports her side of the mission was successful, and soldiers from all over the battlefield are now on their way to this location. She asks you what you think the next step is.

You remind her that the Gambit's whereabouts are unknown, but if he's planning to get his revenge, then that means he'll inevitably return to Skaia. Knowing this, you believe the best course of action is to wait for him. That will also give other soldiers around the battlefield time to congregate here and to replenish their gear if necessary. The White King and Queen agree with this. The Black King seems to be too busy glaring at the White King to hear what you're saying, but you imagine he'd have the same idea.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1061_wait.gif[/img]

And so, you wait. Various groups of soldiers head off to nearby castles to gear up. Other soldiers from around the battlefield slowly trickle into the area, joining your ever growing army.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1062_overkill.gif[/img]

Surely, the number of soldiers you have is overkill. Overkill seems like a fitting way for the Gambit to go out, though, so you'll take it.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1063_army.gif[/img]

He can't kill all of you. He can try, but there's not a chance in hell you will lose.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1064_gambit_saber.gif[/img]

So what are you waiting for, Gambit? You want your revenge?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1065_gambit.gif[/img]

Then come and fucking get it.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1066_skaia_planet.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/inter2/a1067_skaia_mobius.gif[/img]

...Now you can't see anything but the screen. Ugh. You really weren't sure what you were expecting, to be honest.

Well, at least you can MAYBE make use of this. You can equip it very briefly if you need quick access to a hands-free computer.

You briefly consider putting your makeshift eyepatch back on, but you want to make a cooler patch. You have an idea, but you don't think it's very feasible... unless...

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1214_2_brook_icaptcha.gif[/img]

You make the iCAPTCHA!

This beauty works similarly to the famed CAPTCHAROID CAMERA in that it can create ghost images, which you can use to grab the code of something you normally can't! Unlike the Captcharoid Camera however, it can also SEARCH THE WEB for ghost images, allowing you to obtain the code of PRACTICALLY ANYTHING THAT HAS EVER EXISTED! 

The price is quite steep, but it's one you're more than willing to pay. In fact, you're surprised it's not higher, considering this is quite possibly the most useful item ever created.

The possibilities were already infinite, but now they are... more infinite.

...You have no idea what to search up. It's too overwhelming. You'll stick to taking pictures for now. Speaking of which, time to enact that idea you had.

You're not too sure about this one. It's another outfit that's a bit too stiff for you and you're not really crazy about the superhero-esque look. And that's not even mentioning the new functional digital eye on your chest. It just kinda makes your head hurt, having to see through 3 eyes now. 

Perhaps you're overdoing it a little on the recipes. Maybe you'd get the best result from something simpler.

Now that you have an outfit that works, you're gonna quit while you're ahead. No more outfits. Before you bring the montage to a close though, there's a couple more things you wanna try.

Awww, he's so cute! ...How the hell do you activate him though? You think you could do it, but you'll hold off for now. You've got more important stuff to do. You'll just try to make a robot that's activated by default.

You make ROBOT GLASSES!

...On second thought, nevermind. You don't think you wanna experiment anymore. In one fell swoop, you've lost your alchemy appetite.

You immediately discard the Robot Glasses.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1232_brook_postalc.gif[/img]

And with that, the montage is over! Now it's time to go play around with all of this stuff for real. It's adventuring time!

...For Brook, that is. We've got some place else to be right now, don't we?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1235_ot_reveal.gif[/img]

An OTHERWORLDLY TRAVELLER wanders a desert unfamiliar to him.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1236_ot_intro.gif[/img]

You do that.

You've recently arrived on this foreign planet, the sun is quickly setting, and there's no sign of life nor water for miles. You are in quite the predicament.

You surely won't be able to get any sleep tonight, but you still need to set up a fire to stay warm.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1237_ot_trees.gif[/img]

You keep walking in the direction you were previously headed and soon happen across some dead trees. Thank the Gods, this is exactly what you needed.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1238_ot_wood.gif[/img]

You start picking apart the tree and soon have in your hands a BUNDLE OF FIREWOOD. Perfect!

...You suddenly feel like you're being watched.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1239_ot_watched.gif[/img]

...Nothing there. But you seriously can't shake the feeling there's someone else out here with you. You've been feeling like you're not alone ever since you got here.

Maybe this planet just gives off that kind of energy. Well, whatever. You need to get this fire going before it gets too cold.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1240_ot_fire.gif[/img]

You manage to get a fire going and you sit next to it, bathing yourself in the heat. Good thing you have this cloak on, you can't be having your skin completely dry out. You wouldn't die, but it absolutely wouldn't be pleasant.

There's nothing else to do tonight but stay alert. That strange feeling still lingers and it's making you too paranoid to sleep.

You are now RYAN.

You've just re-entered your house and have moved upstairs to your Alchemiter. You also told Sansprite he could take another break in the living room. You wanna try going on this next part of your adventure solo.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1294_ryan_upwards.gif[/img]

Wow, that is quite the tall tower. Your objective, your first gate, sits right up there at the top. 

First, however, comes the need for some foot protection. Shouldn't be too costly, time or grist-wise. You have an idea as to how you're gonna make some Long Fall Boots, and you can't see how it could possibly fail.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1295_ryan_portalshoes.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1295_2_ryan_portalshoes.gif[/img]

You make the APERTURE SCIENCE FOOTHELD PORTAL DEVICE(S). 

Uhh. Well shit, now you've got shoes that shoot portals. Okay, no problem, you had a feeling something like this could happen. You've got a fallback combination. Let's change that && to an ||, shall we?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1296_ryan_armorshoes.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1296_2_ryan_armorshoes.gif[/img]

You make the APERTURE SCIENCE PROTECTIVE FOOTWEAR.

Goddamn it. These are just normal shoes but with some armor. They look cool and all, but this still isn't what you were going for at all. You don't have any more fallback combinations, so you guess you're gonna try whatever random shit comes to mind.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1297_ryan_combinations.gif[/img]

You run through a few more combinations, trying anything related to Aperture Science. You get some real weird shit, but no boots to be found. Well, you have one more idea you can try.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1298_ryan_atlas.gif[/img]

You look to the deactivated ATLAS you made earlier, and remember something. ATLAS in the game doesn't take fall damage, right? Maybe that'll be factored into the alchemy here?

You really don't think this'll work, but you're just about out of options. It's worth a shot, at least.

p.c: Ryan: Combine Aperture Science Protective Footwear && ATLAS
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1299_ryan_lfb.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1299_2_ryan_lfb.gif[/img]

You make the APERTURE SCIENCE LONG FALL BOOTS!

Yes! Finally! You were really starting to doubt you could make these things at all, but you did it! ...Man, these are kind of uncomfortable, actually. You think you're just gonna take these off for now and wear them only when you need to.

Well, that was kind of a waste of time. Oh well, at least you have some pretty cool shoes to wear later. Now all that's left here is to get to the top of your house.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1300_ryan_outsidedoor.gif[/img]

You walk to the top of the first staircase and are met with a door. Right, there aren't just gonna be staircases up, you've gotta get through a bunch of rooms too. You doubt any of the rooms are anything but completely empty, but you wouldn't put it completely past Brook to fuck with you by making each room a maze.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1301_ryan_improom.gif[/img]

Well, it's not a maze thankfully... but damn, there are a lot of imps in here. You don't know which is worse actually, but at least you know Brook isn't responsible for this.

p.c: Ryan: Get those imps outta here.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1302_ryan_impblast.gif[/img]

Out of the way, assholes! You've got places to be!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1303_ryan_gate.gif[/img]

You repeat this process a few times until you finally reach the first gate. 

You're probably gonna just jump in this thing and then head straight for the second gate. You'd like to start meeting up with the others as soon as possible now that you're all properly situated here. Maybe you'll stop to check out some dungeons if you happen upon them though.

Alright, enough planning. Let's do this thing.

[color=#ff9f00]In our first attempt, we had already matured. We were the ancestors of a group of children that seemingly wanted nothing to do with this game.

[spoiler open="Open Scybdislog" close="Hide Scybdislog"]
[color=#ff9f00]Afterwards, our universe began anew. We were alive again, initially without memory of our past lives. We had switched roles with our descendants. They were now our ancestors.[/color][/spoiler]

[spoiler open="Open Scybdislog" close="Hide Scybdislog"]
[color=#ff9f00]Then, the game presented itself again. Rather than our ancestors playing it, as we once did, things turned out differently.[/color][/spoiler]

[spoiler open="Open Scybdislog" close="Hide Scybdislog"]
[color=#ff9f00]As the game progressed, we discovered that, as our same group played this game in both iterations of our universe, the game granted us something special.

Each of us had two mythological roles. Two classes, and two aspects. This was true of both iterations, as if the game knew ahead of time we would Scratch and play again in the alternate universe.

With the powers of both MIND and BLOOD combined, one of us came to remember our alternate selves. He remembered our failure, the Scratch, and our leader's betrayal.[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1358_scyb_confront.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Scybdislog" close="Hide Scybdislog"]
[color=#ff9f00]When we confronted our leader about this, he vowed he would not repeat the disgusting actions of his alternate self.

Victory would be impossible if we weren't all working together. Not to mention, he had been given the roles of both TIME and SPACE. We had no choice but to trust in his promise for the time being.[/color][/spoiler]

[color=#ff9f00]We tried conceiving another plan. Our leader talked with some of your kind, where you gave us coordinates to your location. With this, we formed a new idea. 

Perhaps, with enough power, we could relocate. We could bring ourselves to your world. Your universe.[/color][/spoiler]

[color=#ff9f00]And so, we combined our powers together. The powers of SPACE, of TIME, of HOPE, of HEART, of RAGE, and so on. We threw in everything we had, and put in as much of our energy as possible.[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1404_april_return.gif[/img]

Well, that was quite the battle you had outside... You're still not sure how you feel about killing all those poor underlings, or about your role as the Maid of Rage. You're still a bit uneasy.

Flower's advice and explanation did help a bit. You know now why your mood would swing so suddenly and violently, but you're not sure if you'll be able to keep it under control. Flower believes in you though, and you'd hate to let her down. 

She told you before you came home that you should have yourself an alchemy binge. That'll get your mind off of things for a while, and you'll need the gear anyway. So you know what, that's exactly what you're going to do. You've been really looking forward to this!

p.c: April: Get ready to commence alchemy binge.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1405_april_alchdeny.gif[/img]

Wait, "get ready"? Oh, right. You got a little ahead of yourself. Tim has already started his binge. That's alright, you're happy to wait your turn!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1406_tim_lasertop.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1406_2_tim_lasertop.gif[/img]

To start things off, you create the LASER PROJECTED SCREEN. Damn, this shit really is cool. 

You were aiming for something just a little bit more portable. Lucky for you, more can be done with this. You should try combining this with something to go around your wrist, like a watch maybe. You don't have anything like that on you right now though, so to the iCaptcha you go!

You look up the code for a WATCH on the iCaptcha.

p.c: Tim: Combine Laser Projected Screen && Watch
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1407_tim_laserwrist.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1407_2_tim_lasewrist.gif[/img]

You create the WRIST MOUNTED LASER PROJECTED SCREEN. Hell yes! This is exactly what you were looking for! A super light and portable computing system, powered by lasers!

Now you gotta make something to better defend yourself with. The laser pointer's not gonna do much. You think a GUN would work perfectly, but you don't know how to use one. If you combine the two, though...

You look up the code for a PISTOL on the iCaptcha.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1408_tim_laserpistol.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1408_2_tim_laserpistol.gif[/img]

You make the LASER PISTOL. There we are. It's a great sidearm, for sure. Now for the main weapon.

You look up the code for a RIFLE on the iCaptcha.

p.c: Tim: Combine Laser Pistol && Rifle && Fidget Spinner
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1409_tim_tblaserrifle.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1409_2_tim_tblaserriflel.gif[/img]

You make the TRIPLE BARREL LASER RIFLE. The barrels spin rapidly as you fire the weapon. You bet this is capable of dishing out a ton of damage, but it feels like it's gonna overheat after only a second of firing. Good thing you have a reliable sidearm to compliment it!

You already have all the weapons you need to survive and thrive, but it wouldn't be fun to stop there. Let's keep this weapon train moving!

p.c: Tim: Combine Laser Pointer && Fortnite poster
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1410_tim_raygun.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1410_2_tim_raygun.gif[/img]

You make the RAY GUN. Very, very similar to your other weapons in function, but now it looks like something outta Fortnite. You think you remember this weapon from the game, actually. That's so awesome.

p.c: Tim: Combine Laser Pistol || Lava Lamp
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1411_tim_lavacannon.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1411_2_tim_lavacannon.gif[/img]

You make the LAVA CANNON. This thing is sick. It fires explosive balls of wax, like a grenade launcher. Doesn't keep a lot of ammo in it though. You'll have to conserve the "lava" for a time when you really need to deal some damage.

p.c: Tim: Combine Wrist Mounted Laser Projected Screen && Laser Pistol
p.b:

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1412_2_tim_wristlaser.gif[/img]

You make the DEADSHOT. This seems like it'll be fun. It's just the Laser Pistol, but hands-free. You wonder if it has the computing capabilities of the laser screen, but you really don't know if you wanna test that here.

p.c: Tim: Combine Triple Barrel Laser Rifle && Refrigerator
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1413_tim_subzerogun.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1413_2_tim_subzerogun.gif[/img]

You make the SUBZERO MACHINE GUN. Goddamn, it's freezing. You don't think you can hold it for very long without losing all feeling in your hands. You're not gonna use this gun much unless you can make some gloves.

Speaking of which, you think you've got enough weapons for now. How about a new outfit?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1414_tim_astroskin.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1414_2_tim_astroskin.gif[/img]

You make the ASTROSKIN. Pink's not usually your favorite color, but.. you think this actually looks pretty damn good on you.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1415_2_tim_futurefit.gif[/img]

You make the FUTURE FIT. Well, it fits in with your whole laser motif at least. You wanna try something else, though. You're not really feeling this one.

p.c: Tim: Combine Clothes && Battlefield poster || Doritos Nacho Cheese bag

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1416_2_tim_redcorps.gif[/img]

You make the RED CORPS SUIT. It looks cool as fuck, but it's pretty uncomfortable to wear. You can't say you're surprised, what with it being a military outfit. You're liking this direction more though, so how about something similar? 

You like the camo design of your bed's blanket, but you don't know where the hell April put it. So instead, you look up the code for a CAMO PATTERN on the iCaptcha.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1417_tim_woodlander.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1417_2_tim_woodlander.gif[/img]

You make the WOODLANDER. This one feels just like your normal outfit. It also looks just a bit too similar. Combining this and the last outfit will surely bring you the result you're looking for.

p.c: Tim: Combine Woodlander || Red Corps Suit
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1418_tim_scarlet.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1418_2_tim_scarlet.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1418_3_tim_scarlet.gif[/img]

You make the SKIRMISHER'S SCARLET. Much better! This has the cool colors and utility of the Red Corps Suit with the comfort of the Woodlander. Yeah, you think you're gonna stick with this one for a while.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1419_tim_postalch.gif[/img]

You'd love to keep going with this, but your grist supply is getting a little low, not to mention there's many kinds of grist you don't yet have apparently. You'll probably get back to this later, but for now, you're gonna go test out all this sweet gear.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1420_april_observe.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1420_2_april_laptop.gif[/img]

...Oh! He's done! That means its your turn now, right?

Alright! Let's get this started!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1421_april_prealch.gif[/img]

While you were waiting, you had a look around the house for stuff you can use. You also tried seeing if Ashley had any recommendations since you haven't talked to her in a while, but she seems to be offline right now. You guess she's busy exploring or something.

You also noticed Tim was using a phone that looked kind of like a captchalogue card to look up new stuff. That sounds pretty neat, so you're gonna try making one of those yourself!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1422_april_icaptcha.gif[/img]

There we are! Now you have an entire internet's worth of items to use in your alchemy binge! So now, what's first?

You wanna jump right into making sweet new outfits, but you think you might need to start with a couple of weapons. You don't really want new weapons, but you're gonna need some to defend yourself better. As a last resort, of course.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1423_april_quadscythe.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1423_2_april_quadscythe.gif[/img]

You make the QUADRASCYTHE! Well, this looks dangerous, and kinda plain... You have an idea as to how to pretty up your tools though! You quickly duck outside and pick up a loose piece of AMETHYST.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1424_april_amethystacreage.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1424_2_april_amethystacreage.gif[/img]

You make the AMETHYST ACREAGE APPARATUS! Okay, you admit, it's pretty! It's not really easy to hold though. Maybe something else will do the trick.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1425_april_scyddle.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1425_2_april_scyddle.gif[/img]

You make the SCYDDLE! D'awww, now that's just cute. It's so soft and cuddly! You love it so much!

...Hang on, you're trying to make weapons here. No, this won't do at all, you need something deadlier here!

p.c: April: Combine Quadrascythe && Music Box && Flower
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1426_april_floweringnight.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1426_2_april_floweringnight.gif[/img]

You make the FLOWERING NIGHT! Yeah, you think this is what you're looking for! Pretty, and looks quite dangerous! You like it! You can faintly hear your music box's tune playing whenever you swing the weapon.

Alright, you should probably finish up with the weapons. All these dangerous objects are making you feel strange again. Next up, you should try making a new computer for yourself to hold on to. You keep forgetting to bring your actual laptop with you. But how can you make it hands-free with what you have on you? You don't want to rely on the iCaptcha too much just yet.

Ah, of course! Your hair tie!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1427_april_hairdown.gif[/img]

This should do the trick!

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1428_april_computie.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1428_2_april_computie.gif[/img]

You make the COMPUTIE! It's small, light, and... well, you wouldn't really say stylish. It actually looks kinda goofy. But you like that, you think it's funny!

Well, that's all the really useful stuff out of the way. It's time to have some fun and make some pretty outfits!

p.c: April: Combine Pink Flower shirt && Teddy Bear || Beanbag
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1429_april_hoodybear.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1429_2_april_hoodybear.gif[/img]

You make the HOODY BEAR! It's so soft and comfy! And very warm. Too warm right now. If it ever gets colder here, you imagine huddling up in this thing is gonna be heavenly.

p.c: April: Combine Pink Flower shirt && Squiddle || Computie
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1430_april_providdles.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1430_2_april_providdles.gif[/img]

You make the PROVIDDLES! It's really cute and silly, but the tentacles constantly flapping around whenever you move is probably gonna bother you later.

p.c: April: Combine Clothes && Farm Equipment || Music Box
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1431_april_darkharvester.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1431_2_april_darkharvester.gif[/img]

You make the DARK HARVESTER! You really feel in your element in this getup. You think the gold's pretty as well. 

Now, what else could you use? Maybe this is the time to take to the iCaptcha! Maybe you could try making some kind of headgear, just for fun?

You look up the code for a BEANIE on the iCaptcha.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1432_april_beaddle.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1432_2_april_beaddle.gif[/img]

You make the BEADDLE! ...Wow, the names of these Squiddle items are creative, aren't they? Anyway, you weren't sure how you'd look in a beanie, but you think you're pulling off the look perfectly! 

Hmmm... alright, maybe just one more outfit. You want something extravagant to finish off your ever growing wardrobe. Now, what's something extravagant? Maybe... a star? Oh, yes, that's perfect!

You look up the code for a STAR on the iCaptcha.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1433_april_superstar.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1433_2_april_superstar.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1433_3_april_superstar.gif[/img]

You make the SUPERSTAR! You feel like an idol in this costume! You don't think you're quite good enough to actually BE an idol.. but who knows? You might just be capable of so much more than you think.

You think you're good on costumes, but you're having too much fun to stop here! What other stuff can you make?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1434_april_digiddle.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1434_2_april_digiddle.gif[/img]

You make the DIGIDDLE! It seems like it wants to follow you wherever you go. You're not too sure if it's cute or scary, but fine, you'll let it tag along for now.

All this Squiddle merchandise is giving you an idea that you're not sure how you didn't think of sooner.

p.c: April: Combine Pink Squiddle && Orange Squiddle
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1435_april_tanglebuds.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1435_2_april_tanglebuds.gif[/img]

You make... TANGLE BUDDIES. Oh. You thought this would make a Squiddle with both colors, but no, it just kinda copied them and then stuck them together. Oh well.

You suddenly got a much better idea for a new toy.

p.c: April: Combine Teddy Bear && Drawing of April
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1436_april_selfdoll.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1436_2_april_selfdoll.gif[/img]

You make an APRIL DOLL! This was the best idea you've ever had! She's so cute! You have to make more of these for each of your friends!

You love them all!!

You're not sure how you can top this, but.. fine, one more toy.

p.c: April: Combine all of your toys together.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1438_april_allhailtheglorioussquiddlegod.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1438_2_april_ouronetruelordandsavior.gif[/img]

You make the TEMPLE OF THE SQUIDDLE GOD.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1439_april_yoursinswillforeverhauntyou.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1440_april_youareabouttomeetaterriblefate.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1441_april_farewellfornow.gif[/img]

...No thanks.

You promptly discard the TEMPLE OF THE SQUIDDLE GOD. This feels like a bad omen.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1442_april_postalch.gif[/img]

On that note, you're gonna quit while you're ahead... but there's something else you wanna play with before you go out exploring again.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1443_april_preupgrade.gif[/img]

What could you do with this now?

p.c: April: Upgrade the Alchemiter with the other machines.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1444_april_fullupgrade.gif[/img]

You integrate all of the other machines into the Alchemiter. Wow, there's so much room in here now! Hey, you kinda forgot there were more tools to use there on the wall. Oh well, maybe you'll have another chance to do alchemy later.

p.c: April: Upgrade the Alchemiter with a Squiddle.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1445_april_squiddleupgrade.gif[/img]

The Alchemiter takes the form of a metal Squiddle. It's now completely useless. At least it's cute though.

p.c: April: Upgrade the Alchemiter with the Tangle Buddies.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1446_april_tanglebuddyupgrade.gif[/img]

Amazing! The Alchemiter now has 2 metal Squiddles for double the uselessness! You need to try something else. You remove the Squiddle themed upgrades to start fresh.

p.c: April: Upgrade the Alchemiter with a Pot.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1447_april_potupgrade.gif[/img]

Like any other pot, this new Pot Alchemiter won't do anything on its own. It needs soil! You don't have any around here though, most of the spare soil that was here seems to have been left back on Earth, so you take to the iCaptcha and look up the code for a BAG OF SOIL.

In the meantime, you also decide to take some of those hanging pots down; the Alchemiter is now getting dangerously close to bumping into them.

p.c: April: Upgrade the Alchemiter with a Bag of Soil.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1448_april_soilupgrade.gif[/img]

There we are! This Alchemiter doesn't seem to create items as you'd expect. However, it now seems to be a source of renewable grist! You should test this out. You insert a piece of BUILD GRIST.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1449_april_soilgristpour.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1450_1451_1452_april_wait.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1450_1451_1452_april_wait.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1450_1451_1452_april_wait.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1453_april_gristsprout.gif[/img]

A larger piece of BUILD GRIST has sprouted! Collecting it yields 20 BUILD GRIST! That's not a huge amount, but for other Grist types that are harder to come by, you can see this thing being really useful. And it gives you a way to earn Grist without needing to fight underlings. Perfect!

Maybe later, you'll get Ryan to put down more Alchemiters so you can start a whole Grist farm. And maybe you'll see if Brook knows any good way of automating the process. You know she likes playing those complex factory automation video games sometimes.

For now you remove the POT and BAG OF SOIL upgrades, but you're no doubt going to go through with that farm idea later.

p.c: April: Upgrade the Alchemiter with the iCaptcha.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1454_april_icaptchaupgrade.gif[/img]

You're not sure how you didn't think of this sooner! The Alchemiter is now outfitted with a screen with which you can use to find ghost images. These images can now be added automatically to your alchemy recipes in addition to presenting you their codes, speeding up the process somewhat. Nice!

p.c: April: Upgrade the Alchemiter with a Quest Bed.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1455_april_bedupgrade.gif[/img]

You looked up an image from Homestuck of a Quest Bed with the iCaptcha upgrade and applied it to the Alchemiter. It can't make items anymore, even though it looks like it probably should be able to. You think it actually functions as a Quest Bed, but you're really not willing to die on top of it to find out.

You've run out of ideas here, you think. You've already found the most interesting upgrades, and you're getting the itch to go back outside again. You're gonna bring this extended alchemy/upgrade binge to a close, but you had a lot of fun here!
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1456_ryan_river.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1457_ryan_appear.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1458_ryan_bridge.gif[/img]

Yup. It's another boardwalk alright. The novelty of this place wore off pretty quick. You should find that next gate and get yourself out of here ASAP.

This place is a labyrinth though, and you don't have Sansprite here to make any shortcuts for you. You think your best bet is to just stay near the lake.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1459_ryan_grist.gif[/img]

After a quick turn in the boardwalk, you come across some dropped grist. That's strange, how'd that get there? You haven't seen any underlings around these parts yet.

There's always something with this place, isn't there?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1461_ryan_investigate.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1467_ryan_depart.gif[/img]

Well, it was nice catching up, but you have important stuff that needs doing. Namely, getting the hell outta here. You're just gonna take your brother's advice and keep going the way you were going. 

All roads lead to Rome after all, especially on this damn planet.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1468_ryan_glow.gif[/img]

Well, here's a nice straight boardwalk. You can see a very small glow in the distance as well. Is that your second gate? Already? No harm in going and having a look, you guess.

There's also a bunch of diverging paths here. Might as well take a look down them on the way there, maybe there'll be more grist left behind by your brother or something.

p.c: Ryan: Look down the first path.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1469_ryan_path1.gif[/img]

You look down and see.. who is that? You think the person on the right is another you, but.. is that April?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1470_ryan_futureryanapril.gif[/img]

Huh, it actually is! When'd she get here? This has to be a future April, you have no doubt she'd message you if she was coming over. You guess you're gonna be meeting her soon then.

Where'd you get those clothes, though? That must be a you from even further in the future. You're so glad you're into time travel stuff, you have no clue how you'd manage to wrap your head around this stuff otherwise. 

You wanna go talk to them, but April would probably be too weirded out. You'll eventually become that Ryan anyway, so you're not gonna miss anything. You decide not to disturb them.

p.c: Ryan: Look down the second path.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1471_ryan_meetingoftheryans.gif[/img]

You look down the next path and see oh good lord, that's a lot of Ryans. What are they all talking about? 

Actually, you're not sure you wanna know. You're gonna be having this same meeting a whole bunch of times in the future. One of them is even wearing the same outfit as you, so the first meeting probably isn't too far away.

You just realized how casual you're being about seeing all these future yous. That's how fucking nuts your life has become right now, that you're so used to this already. What a weird day.

p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1472_ryan_broagain.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1477_ryan_BIRD.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1479_ryan_totallynotthebigbad.gif[/img]

Oh, there's definitely something back there. The hell is it doing? Is it an underling? Do you need to kill it?

...You think you just heard the tree giggle at you in a really creepy voice. That's.. fucking unnerving. You decide to ignore the giggling tree and just get out of this place.

p.b:

Then again, this is LOBAR, that lake you were just at is probably on the other side of the planet.

...

This one could be a problem.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1507_jack_pinned.gif[/img]

You're about to open your mouth to say something, but your radio starts buzzing. God fucking damn it, what shitty timing. And of course it's a transmission from HER, of all people. No, you can't pick up the walkie-talkie, QUEEN, you're busy.

You try again to reply to the kid when your RULER calls again and demands you pick up. You notice the girl seems to be gesturing towards the walkie-talkie. Alright, FINE, you'll pick up. You go to retrieve your radio but you accidentally drop it. Fuck.

You hear the RULER say Archagent, for fucks sake, what are you doing. The girl sighs and lets go of you and says hurry the fuck up and answer already. What a fucking mess.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1508_jack_bq.gif[/img]

You say what the hell do you want, you're busy. She says finally. She has a very important job for you and you need to listen carefully. You sigh and say what is it. She tells you the Gambit is loose. You say the what? She asks how the fuck don't you know who the Gambit is, you've been briefed on this countless times. You say does she really think you listen to her briefings, half the stuff she spouts is complete nonsense.

She sighs and tells you there's really no time for your attitude. You say you don't care about no Gambit, you've got more important matters to attend to right now. She asks what possibly could be more important than this? You say, for starters, the Draconian Dignitary has reported the Knight has woken up and has fled Derse, so you have to investigate the matter and file the appropriate paperwork. She says she'll give a lower ranking agent the hero monitoring duties, but she needs you and your agents on high alert. You go quiet for a moment then say fine. Over and out.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1509_jack_answers.gif[/img]

The kid suddenly asks now, can you PLEASE explain to her who the fuck you are and what's going on. This shit is ridiculous, you think. Being threatened by a kid. You don't have time for this, you say. You have important matters to attend to, as she clearly would've heard just a second ago. You glance at your knife on the ground but the girl notices and aims her freaky red eyeball knife at you again. She says you're so lucky you're not dead yet, but she will not hesitate to cut you to pieces if you do not answer her questions.

This girl really means business. You half expected this from the reports you've been given about her, but you didn't think she would be THIS hardcore. Honestly, you can respect that. You state your name and rank to her and repeat what you told the QUEEN about the Knight waking up and you investigating the matter. She says that doesn't answer anything and asks why were you in her room with a knife. You admit you were thinking about killing her. She looks at you funny and quietly mutters something you don't understand.

She then asks why you tried to kill her. You pause for a second then say that's not for her to know. She says it absolutely the fuck is for her to know. You pause again and say look, whatever objective you had has gone out the window with this Gambit bullshit, whatever the hell that is. She asks what is the Gambit? You say for the last time, you don't fucking know. She says holy shit, you're fucking useless, just get out of her room already, she has enough on her plate right now. You ask if you can at least retrieve your knife. She gives you a death glare. Guess that's a no. Whatever, you'll come back later for it.
