[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1510_2_ashley_confused.gif[/img]

...
...
...
What the fuck was all that about?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1511_ashley_roomexamine.gif[/img]

Hey, now that you're not so distracted, where the fuck are you? It looks like your room but... well, if you're being honest, you like the look of this better than your actual room, but what is this place? Is this that Derse thing you've heard mentioned before? 

And what's up with the writing on the walls? What's your fault? Is it even directed at you? Did you write this? You've got too many questions, and standing around looking at the wall isn't going to answer them. You should go explore outside. That weird Jack creature is probably long gone by now.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1512_ashley_window.gif[/img]

Damn, that's a long drop. You guess you're pretty used to dealing with those by now though. You don't have any devices on you to contact that exile guy right now. Somehow it just now occurred to you that you're not wearing the same clothes you were a few minutes ago in that cave. Actually, wasn't Jeff wearing something like this earlier after his accident?

You vaguely recall a conversation you had with him where he told you about dream selves. You guess that's what you are right now. So you're dreaming, then. You think he also mentioned something about being able to fly, so perhaps that's how you're going to be able to get around this place. If you're a dream self though, then how did you manage to retrieve that knife..? 

No, you're getting off track again. Look around first, ask questions later.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1513_ashley_fly.gif[/img]

Huh. It's surprisingly quick to get used to. Now, where to?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1514_ashley_observe.gif[/img]

You take a look around the whole area, now that you have a much better view of the place. You can just barely make out some movement around the buildings. They look like ants from here, but you assume they're the same creatures as that Jack guy.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1515_ashley_shuttle.gif[/img]

Some movement elsewhere catches your eye. You see what appears to be some kind of ship flying off. Where is it going?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1516_ashley_planets.gif[/img]

It seems to be heading towards that distant group of other planets. Hey, you think that's your planet back there! You hope that ship's not heading to your place. You'll have to try and wake yourself up soon, just in case. There's not a whole lot you can do about that ship now, so you might as well go check out one of those other towers.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1517_ashley_flying.gif[/img]

On your way to this tower, you start getting that uneasy feeling again. The memory of what had just occurred minutes ago in that cave is beginning to seep back into your mind. 

What exactly happened down there? What are those Scybdis-kind creatures that wrote the story on the wall? And the biggest question of all, who the hell is ISI..?

Your throat tightens as you recall its name again. You need to distract yourself, you think. Usually you'd go on walks through the woods to clear your head. Maybe you'll touch down in the city below and just wander for a moment before getting back to investigating.

p.c: Ashley: Fly down to the city.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1518_ashley_chain.gif[/img]

As you fly downwards, you spot someone climbing that huge chain. 

It's probably just Jack again, right?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1522_gambit_reintro.gif[/img]

You are now the GAMBIT.

You have just equipped a mysterious mask that did some real weird shit to your head. You feel strong. Stronger than you ever have before. Is it a smart idea to keep wearing this thing? Probably not, but you don't care about the potential danger. All you care about is enacting your revenge. And so, that is what you are going to do.

...You decided to keep the weird smiley face graphic on your mask. You think it'd be useful for luring your enemies into a false sense of security. You like the sound of that idea.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1523_gambit_queen.gif[/img]

You have decided your first target shall be the BLACK QUEEN. The news of her death would surely hit the BLACK KING where it really hurts. That is, assuming he even has emotions. Well, the Queen's gotta die anyway, might as well test your theory.

The Queen will be found in her chamber on Derse, of course. You can't see her being anywhere else, except for maybe the Archagent's office, antagonizing him as she tends to do. This should be easy.

p.c: Gambit: Look for a way out.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1524_gambit_derseportal.gif[/img]

There's usually transportalizers on these meteor laboratories, so heading to Derse won't be hard. In fact, you've already found the transportalizer. Time to get outta here.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1525_gambit_transportalize.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1526_gambit_chain.gif[/img]

Well, here you are. Right next to the chain. Actually, before meeting the Queen.. you have a plan for this chain, too. Might as well carry it out while you're here.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1527_gambit_bomb.gif[/img]

This device you found with the other stuff... You're going to use it on the top of the chain, right underneath the moon. 

If this is really a bomb, and not just a fancy alarm clock, it's going to utterly annihilate the entire chain and perhaps the moon as well. The debris should deal with the rest of Derse.

The destruction of Derse shall send the proper message to the King that you are not to be underestimated. And those heroes resting in the moon's towers... they shall be destroyed with the rest of the moon. That will be your final "fuck you" to the royalty.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1528_gambit_leap.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1528_2_gambit_moon.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1528_3_gambit_climb.gif[/img]

You'd use another transportalizer to get to the moon, but you don't want to draw too much attention. This may take a while.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1529_gambit_notice.gif[/img]

Who the hell's that? You think that was the Queen's personal shuttle... you hope the fuck not. Where could she even be going? And why the hell now?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1530_gambit_planets.gif[/img]

It looks like she might be headed to Prospit or even Skaia. If that's the case... you may have already been discovered. 

After you finish up with this task, you'll still head down to the Queen's chamber on the off chance that wasn't her flying away. There'll be some backup shuttles nearby to get yourself back down to Skaia anyway.

Oh, and who the fuck is that, now?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1531_gambit_ashley.gif[/img]

Damn, looks like one of the heroes has woken up already. You're really going to need to hurry this along, then. 

She just keeps staring at you with that weird look on her face. ...She thinks you look fucking ridiculous, doesn't she?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1532_gambit_ashvanish.gif[/img]

She disappeared. You know what, you're not gonna question it. The less distractions, the better. Let's get that bomb attached.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1533_gambit_bomb.gif[/img]

Bomb has been planted.

You're not seeing an "activate" or "arm" button though. Looks like you'll have to do some rewiring.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1534_gambit_bombopen.gif[/img]

The bomb's front was able to open up without much effort. This shouldn't take too long.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1535_gambit_rewire.gif[/img]
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1536_gambit_droll.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1537_gambit_drollyell.gif[/img]

An annoying voice starts demanding to know what you're doing and screaming at you to stop. Ugh. You think that's the Droll. Whatever, the bomb's more important. Maybe he'll go away.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1538_gambit_drollannoy.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1539_gambit_drollcall.gif[/img]

Nope, he's still here. Sigh.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1540_gambit_drolldead.gif[/img]

Finally, peace and quiet.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4/1541_gambit_activate.gif[/img]

That should do it. The bomb is now armed, and is set to go off 2 hours from now. That should be far more than enough time to finish your business here. 

Now to get to the Queen's chambers. It'll be quite the walk and some resistance is to be expected, especially now that the Droll's dead. You can't imagine the other agents will be happy to hear about that.

You suddenly remember the room. You remember your father, often secluding himself here to sleep or watch TV. You remember his total apathy towards you. You could never spend time with him. The truth is, he never cared about you. Why he even kept you is a mystery to you. It hurts to think about.

You don't know where he went, or what he was doing after his departure. Knowing what the world has become, you can't imagine he's alive anymore.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1873_frame.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1873_2_exile_frame.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Exilelog" close="Hide Exilelog"]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Hey, you think that's it?[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: our way into the session? probably.
FO: i doubt it's another generator, but we should still check around the place to see if this is related to that one project.[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: I sure hope it's not another generator. I'm tired of turning on generators.
GC: Look, there's a control panel. Let me have a look at this.[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1874_exile_password.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Exilelog" close="Hide Exilelog"]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Hm. Needs a password. Any ideas?[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: if i had to guess, it'd probably be a name or something. we'll have to try and find some clues.
FO: though considering how much important stuff is redacted around here, that might be a hassle.[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Yeah, that's a problem.
GC: Worst case scenario though, I could probably try my hand at hacking into it.[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: only if you're confident you won't break anything.[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: I'm not, but if we're left with no other choice...
GC: Well, for now I'll just try typing in whatever comes to mind.
GC: Could you look around and try to find a more concrete clue somewhere?[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: alright.[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1875_exile_desks.gif[/img]

You quickly find some desks on the other side of the room. Maybe the documents scattered across them could provide a clue?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1876_exile_redacted.gif[/img]

Proving your point earlier, most of these documents are redacted for whatever reason. You don't think these will be of any help.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1877_exile_computer.gif[/img]

Miraculously, this computer actually works and isn't password protected. If you're gonna find useful information, it's gonna be here. You can't say you've ever heard of this brand, and even the operating system doesn't seem like your typical Windows. Perhaps it's a bootleg.

You take mental note of the name "FUTURE". Maybe that could be a password for the control panel.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1878_exile_folder.gif[/img]

After a bit of digging, you find a folder filled with old archived emails. You'll try looking through some of the more recent dates.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1879_exile_email1.gif[/img]

Unredacted names. Maybe one of these could be the password? You'll dig a bit deeper before you return to GC.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1880_exile_email2.gif[/img]

Some more names. You'll keep these ones in mind too and keep going.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1881_exile_email3.gif[/img]

Hmm... it seems like there was a forced password reset after a generator failure.

With all the information you've gathered, you have some ideas as to what the password could be. You should get back to GC now.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1882_exile_guessing.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Exilelog" close="Hide Exilelog"]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Maybe... "portal"?
GC: No, how about... what are the portals actually called again? Reality cracks? Yeah, "reality crack".
GC: Nope. Maybe it's "realitycrack"? Nah, if I do every variation of the same thing we'll be here forever...
GC: "projectp"... No.
GC: What was the password to that first generator? ...It was... "MORTEM". Nope, uh...
GC: Surely the password has some relation to the project, right? ...If the password is "password" I'm gonna fucking scream. ...Alright, it's not.
GC: Uh... ..."swordfish".[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: having trouble?[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Oh, hey. Found something?[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: i have some ideas. might be a long shot, but...
FO: try "turner".[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1883_exile_accepted.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Exilelog" close="Hide Exilelog"]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: "turner"...
GC: Holy shit, it actually worked.[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: first try. i knew it.[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: How'd you manage to find that out?[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: i found some emails that mentioned some kind of incident with a dr. turner.
FO: supposedly this turner and the doctor in charge of this portal project, dr. michael s, were close.
FO: in addition, there was a generator malfunction around this time that forced some password resets.
FO: so i just figured, if michael had to reset his password, he probably would've set it to something important to him, like turner's name.
FO: ...who i'm guessing either did something bad or passed away around that time.[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Smart. Very well done.
GC: Now, let's see what we can do here.[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1884_exile_menus.gif[/img]

Multiple options appear on the screen. What should you try first?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1885_exile_status.gif[/img]

You skip the "ACTIVATE" option for now and check the STATUS menu. 

Well, it's good to know there's no faults with the machine despite not being maintained for who knows how long. The 0% charge is slightly concerning though. Can you charge it from somewhere here perhaps? Should the power level being at 120% concern you too? You'll see soon enough, you guess.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1886_exile_config.gif[/img]

You seem to be able to charge the machine from here, as well as alter the power level. Can't change the coordinates without permission from an administrator though. Considering they're all dead, you can't imagine you'll be getting that any time soon. Maybe there's an admin terminal somewhere in the building, but for now, you see no reason to touch this option anyway.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1887_exile_power.gif[/img]

You decide to lower the power level a little. You don't want to potentially overload this thing. You can always increase it again later if needed.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1888_exile_report.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Exilelog" close="Hide Exilelog"]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: so, how's it looking?[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: No faults found, which is good.
GC: Power level was at 120%, so I decreased it a little to make sure we don't overload the machine.
GC: No charge in it though, and there's a coordinates option we can't change without admin permission.
GC: Says we can charge it from the config menu though, so what do you say? Should we charge it up and see what happens?[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: i don't see why not.[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Alright. Beginning charge.[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1889_exile_charge.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1889_2_machine_hum.gif[/img]

The machine begins emitting a low hum. You... think you did it right? You should check the STATUS menu again just to be sure.

p.c: GC: Check the STATUS menu again.
p.b:
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1890_exile_charging.gif[/img]

The menu says it's currently charging, so it looks like it worked. Seems like all you have to do now is wait.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1891_exile_prewait.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Exilelog" close="Hide Exilelog"]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Everything looks good here. Just have to wait for it to charge.[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: how long will that take?[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Can't tell. Charge is still listed at 0% though.
GC: Let's wait and see how long it takes to at least hit 1%. That way we'll have an idea of how long we'll have to wait.[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1892_exile_waiting.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Exilelog" close="Hide Exilelog"]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: ...[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: ...[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: ...[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: ...[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: 1% yet?[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Nope.[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: ...[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1893_exile_later.gif[/img]

[spoiler open="Open Exilelog" close="Hide Exilelog"]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: ...[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: ...[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: ...[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Oh, there we go, 1%.[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: that was, what, 5 minutes?[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Around that.
GC: So let's see, that means.. it's gonna take about 8 to 9 hours.[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: sweet fucking moses.[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Honestly, that's not as long as I thought it'd take, considering this thing's a portal.[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: yeah, good point.
FO: alright, well i suppose we should head back to the monitor room and keep an eye on the kids while this thing charges.[/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Agreed. 
GC: I wonder how long we've been down here. The whole day's probably come and gone at this point.[/color]
[color=#ff9f00]FO: in that case, we should probably come back at sunrise. [/color]
[color=#00ebdc]GC: Right. Let's head back, then.[/color][/spoiler]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1895_tim_giclopsshot.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1897_tim_drained.gif[/img]

You're not really feeling this anymore. Whether your dad is truly alive or dead, that whole experience just kinda soured your day.

...You wanna go home.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1898_tim_glow.gif[/img]

You see something glowing up there. Guess you should investigate, or whatever.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1899_tim_node.gif[/img]

The glow seems to have been another gate. It looks a bit different than the ones above your apartment. Or does it? You honestly can't remember.

Well, you guess you should jump in. Couldn't hurt. Probably. Might throw you down another huge pit. You don't really have the energy to give a shit right now.
[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1900_tim_enter.gif[/img]

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1901_tim_room.gif[/img]

Wow, the gate actually took you right back to your room. You weren't expecting this game to be nice for once. You'll take it. Now you can finally-

Oh, right. You forgot. You can't lay down because your damn bed's gone and your room's filled with a bunch of fucking cubes. Thank you April, very cool. Whatever, you'll go lay down on the couch. You also just realized how hungry you are, so you should probably grab a snack while you're at it.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1902_tim_fridge.gif[/img]

There's not much in here that's appealing to you right now. You see some leftover pasta in there, maybe... ..Oh, that's definitely expired. 

You think you remember Ryan and Brook talking about alchemy burgers. Maybe you'll give alchemy food a try.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1903_tim_lightsout.gif[/img]

Oh, what the fuck now?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1904_tim_figure.gif[/img]

You feel someone.. or something's presence.

...This feels familiar. You'd appreciate it if whatever's stalking you could at least be a bit more sensitive, considering what's happened recently.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1905_tim_draw.gif[/img]

Well guess what, creepy dark figure?

You're not gonna be afraid of this shit anymore.

YOU'VE GOT DEADLY LASERS NOW.

Part of you regrets kicking Tim like that. Of course, he deserved it... but on top of potentially witnessing his father's death? ..That seemed like too much.

You don't think you would've gone through with it if you knew what happened. As much as it irks you to do, you'll try to remember to apologise to him the next time you see him.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1917_ashley_tower.gif[/img]

For now, you need to keep moving. The gate you need to enter should be somewhere up there. From there, you'll be able to reach your fourth gate and, by extension, April's house.

You hear some strange noises coming from the tower. It seems like your journey upwards won't be so peaceful.

You are the GAMBIT.

You have recently murdered two human adults. Likely parental figures for the younger heroes. They're probably going to come seeking revenge soon, but you're not worried. They only just arrived after all. They're too inexperienced and too underprepared to take you down.

Even more recently, you murdered the remaining agents of Derse, including the archagent Jack Noir. 

Jack had proposed to you a deal earlier: to simply take him with you to the battlefield and let him take the Black Queen's ring. Thinking back on it, you wonder if taking the deal might have been a better option. It's not as if you had much to lose; you couldn't care less about the Queen's ring. Even if Jack was lying and had planned to betray you, you could have simply taken him down then. 

This mask greatly amplifies your power, but also appears to amplify your aggression. It clouds your judgement. You can't say you weren't bloodthirsty before, but maybe, just maybe, things would have gone down differently with Jack had you left the mask behind. You honestly held some respect for him, and for his similar hatred of the royalty. 

You wonder...

Are you making the correct choices?

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1947_gambit_maskup.gif[/img]

Right. You can't afford to second guess yourself right now. Not while the King and Queen are still breathing. You'll have plenty of time to reflect on your actions after they're dead. [img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1948_gambit_clean.gif[/img]

You don't particularly mind being coated in blood, but you don't fully trust that it won't damage your clothes. They do appear to be partly digital after all, having been alchemized with the mask.

The blood comes out of your clothes surprisingly easy. You guess you'll just wipe it on the identically red carpet where no-one will notice it. ...Though, you guess that point's kind of moot with all the corpses in the room.

[img]https://file.garden/W8aioswzE0BjIquL/act4part2/1949_gambit_cleaned.gif[/img]

You'd draw way too much attention, especially now that the agents are dead. You don't think the news has gotten out yet, but you'd rather it didn't until you're off Derse. Looks like you're gonna have to stealth this one.

Yeah I'm pretty sure most of you saw this one coming.

So, here we are at the end of Sburb: Refresh. I'm sorry this is how it had to end, but let's be honest, this is the only way it possibly could have ended at this point. My motivation to work on it has fallen dramatically over the past few years, even before I started the behemoth that was [S] Overkill, and now I just don't have it in me anymore. Honestly I'm surprised I got this massive finale project out, especially in the time that I did. 

I started Sburb: Refresh back in 2018, and since then, I've learned so much from it. Enough to know now that the story I wanted to write back then was a complete dumpster fire (at least, in my eyes it was). I felt like it was too late to really deviate from that plan, but I still tried to power through and get it done. But how long would that have taken? How many years? Do I really still want to be working on this 5, maybe 10 years from now? No, no I don't. 

I want to move on. Start something new, that won't be tied to this story. 

I'm still planning to finish the Act 1 remake at some point. I don't want to make any promises though, just in case. Still, it'd feel appropriate to properly send this adventure off by going back to where it began, right? I was also planning on doing some post-canon stuff on the Discord eventually, which I guess could still happen from time to time. Who knows.

Alright, time to wrap this thing up. Huge thanks to everyone who read Sburb: Refresh, especially those who were there in the earlier days and stuck with it for this long. Whether you loved it, or hated it, or read the first page and immediately stopped caring about it, I appreciate your time. And a special thanks to everyone who made any kind of fan content for Sburb: Refresh. I greatly appreciate all of it, more than you know. 


Thank you.

See you on the other side.
